00ផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់ឡើងវិញ 2026-11-08 (ល្ងាច)

ថ្មីជាង: មើល §00b (2026-11-09).

ចម្លើយ: មិនទាន់រួចទាំងអស់ទេ។ Commit fix ទាំងអស់នៅក្នុង branch គោល; gates Core, Panel, Launcher ជាប់; Website tsc និង Core docs/legal -copies បរាជ័យ (ខាងក្រោម)។ ការអានកូដម្ដងមួយៗលើ 124 ID ដែលហៅថា “កែរួច” រកឃើញ 1 មិនទាន់កែ (L-047) និង 21 កែមួយផ្នែក (22/124 = 17.7% មិនទាន់បញ្ជាក់ពេញ)។ គំរូនេះរួម high និង anomaly ដោយចេតនា ⇒ 17.7% ជាលទ្ធផលគំរូ មិនមែនការប៉ាន់អត្រាទូទៅទេ។ “កែពិត” = បញ្ហាដើមមិនកើតក្នុងកូដ; ផ្នែកដែលមិនទាន់រត់ពិត (UI, live) នៅក្នុងជួរ “អ្វីនៅសល់” របស់ ledger។ ID “កែរួច” 434 ផ្សេងទៀតមានតែភស្តុតាង commit + test (52 ក្នុងនោះ Z រត់ test ប៉ុណ្ណោះ) ⇒ ត្រូវការការផ្ទៀងជ្រៅដូចគ្នា (goal R-REV ក្នុងផ្ទាំង /goal)។ Production នៅ core/v0.27.0: គ្មាន fix ណាមួយដើរលើ production រហូតម្ចាស់ចេញ release។

IDលទ្ធផលអ្វីនៅសល់
C-041កែមួយផ្នែក"What to do" also asked that cluster.Activate/Forget/Drain take a DBTX. Not done: `internal/admin/nodes.go:232-233` `nodeAudit` still records on `s.pool` after `cluster.Drain` / Activate / Forget / Rebalance / Update / Stop have committed (`nodes.go:254,271,287,305,362,375`). A crash or DB blip there leaves a node action with no audit row and returns 500. The ledger admits this ("cluster Drain/Forget … still sit outside"). R2 staying outside was accepted.
C-049កែមួយផ្នែក"What to do" also asked Load to refuse `MAZER_ADS_BUCKET=mazer-releases` when MAZER_ENV=production. It does not: no check in config Load (grep finds only the registry entry `config.go:270`). An env/egg value of mazer-releases still starts and uploads, with only an Attention warning. The live Pterodactyl value has not been checked (owner).
C-053កែមួយផ្នែកThe detail records only `fenced` (bool, database.go:105), not the fence kind asked for (`pr.Fence`, e.g. powered-off/agent). The script row at deploy/host/db-replica.sh:983 still hard-codes actor `'mazerctl'`. The row lives in memory only (`ponytail:` database.go:110), so a restart before the DB returns loses it. The test calls `auditLater` directly and does not go through `AdminPromoteDatabase`.
C-054កែមួយផ្នែកTests do not check either change. TestModerationInputBounds (cmd/mazerd/moderation_test.go:338-341) files one report, so ASC and DESC look the same. No test hits the per-IP 30/h rule; moderation_test.go:132-134 tests only the per-user 10/h. The "what to do" asked for a test of the rate limit and the order. No cursor (deferred by design).
C-059កែមួយផ្នែកgateway.proto:10-12 in the same header still says "When the launcher runs, it connects to Core ... opens one socket per running game", which contradicts line 6. The launcher's stale `PC APP/Mazer Client/docs/contracts/gateway.proto` is still there, and the golden frames are deferred to the owner's repos (ledger notes this).
C-070កែមួយផ្នែក"What to do" also asked for `Reconnect.resume_token` on Move/Drain: gateway.proto:175-177 `Reconnect` still has only `max_delay_ms`; server.go:604 (READY) is still the only mint. A drain still sends every session older than 2 min to POST ticket (300/min per address), so the CGNAT 429 scenario still happens. Only the doc half is fixed. Needs the mod side too (owner's repo) and a drain drill.
C-071កែមួយផ្នែកTwo of the three "what to do" parts are not done. (1) Rooms from Unverified/offline sessions are still counted: Sample :116-126 takes every Live() room, and crowds.go:165-167 says this was left on purpose (owner choice, never recorded as one). (2) CrowdTotals has no LIMIT (internal/crowds/queries.sql:24-30). Today's rows still grow without bound (a bot hopping domains) until the next fold. 20 bots can still put a fake server on the list for as long as they stay.
C-075កែមួយផ្នែក(1) "Advance lastBytes only after a successful beat" is not done: cluster.go:359-364 still sets `n.lastBytes = bytes` before the beat. It is now a `ponytail:` comment, but it is still an undercount during a DB outage. (2) /proc/net/dev inside a Pterodactyl container is that container's network namespace. The OVH quota counts the whole VPS (other containers, host backups, host Postgres replication), so the 80% alert can still come late. Never run on a real host (ledger says "untested on a host"). A one-off read failure (fallback to the counters) makes `bytes < lastBytes`, so that beat counts 0
C-091កែមួយផ្នែកThe message still does not reach Telegram on a hung DB: `telegramSend` (cmd/mazerd/alerts.go:98-99) does two `adm.Secret` DB lookups inside the 15 s send ctx; the first blocks on the hung pool until that ctx expires, falls back to cache, and `Telegram.Send` (alert.go:45) then runs with an expired ctx and fails. That repeats every tick, so the owner hears nothing (an env-set token goes through the same Lookup, integrations.go:160-163). The test's Send uses no DB. Fix: read the secrets under their own short timeout (or from the warm cache first), and keep the Send ctx for the HTTP call.
C-094កែមួយផ្នែកSame mechanism, not covered: `newMedia` cmd/mazerctl/media.go:61 takes `MAZER_MEDIA_BUCKET` default `mazer-media` (config.go:337), production's, under `--staging` (media-audit --repair and the media uploads). Low: the key is pasted per run.
C-095កែមួយផ្នែកSetup sibling still has the old race: `pruneSetup` cdnprune.go:200-231 reads latest.json before List, has no grace and is not re-read before delete (:71 re-checks only the launcher list). `publishSetup` setupfile.go:101-104 deletes the draft marker before writing latest.json, so a prune in that window dooms the new Setup and latest.json points to a 404 (the website download).
C-125កែមួយផ្នែកThe "seen" epoch is only learned by connecting. `db promote` reads the new epoch (dbpromote.go:225) but never writes it to `ctlEpochFile` (ctlpool.go:52-58; the only writer is :79-82). In the finding's own scenario (promote with --old-primary-unreachable, old primary back, tunnel still pointing at it, PC not yet connected to the new primary), the old primary's epoch equals "seen" and writes go through. Fix: promote saves `epoch` to ctlEpochFile.
C-129កែមួយផ្នែកOn a failed watch, `fail` (update.go:332-337) and `restartFailed` (:497) mark the run `failed` before the rollback. During the rollback restart, the contract (retried every minute) can apply; node B then starts on the old release, which gives ErrSchemaAhead. This is the original scenario. Fix: also wait while a recent failed or rolled-back update exists.
C-143កែមួយផ្នែកThe ledger itself (docs/worklog/2026-11-06-audit-A1.md:31) says the "unknown" version bucket and the Panel's "unverified" label were not built. The LIMIT is not per product (queries.sql:70). apps.go:59-62 still accepts any well-formed version, so invented versions still fill the tables and can push out unrecorded older versions.
C-148កែមួយផ្នែក(1) MinReporters ≥ k was not built, so one device can fill all N rows with invented values. (2) Suspected: the rollup only upserts and never deletes rows that fell out of the top N (:79-83), so reruns over the 48 h / 7 d window can grow a bucket past N. The test runs Run once.
C-154កែមួយផ្នែកThe sibling path the finding named is still open: `startup()` (insights/rollup.go:158-165) inserts any telemetry `props->>'version'` into version_daily, kept for ever, with no device ≥ 2 filter.
C-155កែមួយផ្នែកThe manifests and /core/ are not covered. The Worker does not cache latest.json: deploy/cloudflare/download-worker/worker.js:159-160 `latestSetup` reads R2 on every /setup/ request (:382, :403). The live check (cdn apply, first `?x=` request is a HIT) was not run.
C-158កែមួយផ្នែកactive_daily still rebuilds 8 days with the 30-day join (:100-108); the "only the 2 newest days" step was not done, and there is no staging measurement. db.Batch (commit 61e7cde) lifts the 10 s cap, so the long-snapshot risk is back per table.
C-186កែមួយផ្នែកbad-release.en.md:32 and km:32 still say "Roll back: Releases → the row → Offered". "Offered" is only the state label (pages.ts:1142 `hold.none`). The menu item that lifts a hold is "Lift the hold" (pages.ts:1036, versions.tsx:103). The owner would look for a button that does not exist.
C-195កែមួយផ្នែកThe Panel part is not done. src/i18n/locales/en/common.ts:101 and km/common.ts:105 `offlineHelp` still say only "Check that Core is running" and do not mention `mazerctl panel`. The ledger D4:33 admits this.
C-203កែមួយផ្នែកThe ops listener half: deploy/pterodactyl/start.sh:426 still binds `0.0.0.0:${SERVER_PORT}`. It is safe only if the Pterodactyl allocation is 127.0.0.1, which the ledger A2:26 lists as a live-host step. UNVERIFIED here: from a bridge tenant, run `curl <public-ip>:<ops port>/metrics` and expect it to be refused.
C-250កែមួយផ្នែកThe "what to do" also asked to describe the 429 in proto. gateway.proto:18-27 still lists only 401, 503 and 1012. The 429 is described only in openapi.yaml:55.
C-310កែមួយផ្នែក(1) The Panel text "may lag up to 90 s" was never added: no such string in Panel src/i18n (ledger: "Panel work, untested"). (2) live.go:259, the `Forget` comment, still says "the Panel sees it at once", which is the same false claim.
C-321កែមួយផ្នែក(1) The Panel does not use them: no `counted_reporters` or `counted_crashed` anywhere in Panel src outside schema.gen.ts, so the owner still sees the inflated rate. (2) insights/rollup.go:120 version_daily still uses count(*) (ledger: needs a migration).
C-326កែមួយផ្នែកProposals are not merged. In a lasting registration surge, `recent` is true every minute after the automatic action, so sentinel.go:331-337 inserts a new proposal plus an audit row each minute (up to ~60 per hour). The "what to do" asked to merge per signal and kind.
C-337កែមួយផ្នែកThe second half of "what to do" was not done: `secret()` in bootstrap-host.sh:55-70 (and db-replica.sh:468, disk-alert.sh:28, observability.sh) never shreds /etc/mazer/in/<NAME>. Plaintext inputs stay on disk, and on a rerun an old file still wins over a newly typed value.
X-021ត្រូវវាស់ផ្ទាល់Needs a live check: from the PC, 7443-7542 closed on BOX2 and BOX3; BOX2↔BOX3 open; and after a reboot, `iptables -S DOCKER-USER` still has exactly 2 jumps. Not covered: IPv6 (no ip6tables rule), peers dropped on `node remove`, and netdata 19999 and redis on 0.0.0.0 still behind ufw only.
P-008កែមួយផ្នែកCore sends 4 kinds that are in neither KIND_TARGET nor the test, nor in `Sentence`: `ads_bucket_unsafe` (critical, `internal/admin/attention.go:248`), `audit_head_stale` (critical, :291), `node_secrets_exposed` (critical, :315) and `audit_head_unreadable` (:289). P-025កែមួយផ្នែកAn approved proposal (status `approved`, the live 24 h registration close) has an `expires_at` (Core `internal/sentinel/sentinel.go:467`), but `open = i.status === 'open'` (:202). So its end time is never shown, and it is not sorted first. The "when does it revert" scenario still happens for the heaviest action. An open proposal has no `expires_at` at all.
P-026កែមួយផ្នែកThe sentinel-rate row (baseline, cited :162) still prints `settings.none` while `useBaseline` is pending or failed: `settings/index.tsx:84,170` checks only `normal === undefined`. No test.
P-029កែមួយផ្នែក`saved` is the cached query (`index.tsx:95`, staleTime 10 s, refetch on focus in PROD only), with no refetch and no base version before PUT. Two staff on two machines can still undo a Retire. `releases/by-minecraft.tsx:95,161` also writes the whole cached policy. Last-write-wins remains, as the audit accepted.
P-034កែមួយផ្នែកThe "every attention kind has a route" test uses a hand list that misses 4 Core kinds (see P-008), so it cannot catch the regression it was written for. It should read the list from `schema.gen.ts`/openapi.
P-057កែមួយផ្នែកSending that untouched Duplicate still deletes the older unsent draft: `done()` at `composer.tsx:293-301` runs `sessionStorage.removeItem(DRAFT)` because latest equals sent. The draft is lost without asking, the same harm by a sibling path. No test.
P-060កែមួយផ្នែក`switches.configHelp` was not fixed, although the fix asked for it. It still says "Partner servers changes these": `i18n/locales/en/system.ts:13-14`, `km/system.ts:13-14`. That is wrong for game_versions. No test.
L-003កែមួយផ្នែកThe finding also asked to refuse a sealed setup; `switch_account` has no seal check (`game/commands.rs:802-832`). The OS dialog path has no automated test (the ledger says so). Other jars in an official setup can still request a switch; the dialog is the only guard.
L-019កែមួយផ្នែកNothing runs at launcher start, which the finding asked for. A file left raw because the launcher was killed or crashed while the game ran, or one from a setup that is never played again, keeps its token until that same setup's next game ends. The only other cleanup is `storage/sweep.rs:359`, which keeps the newest ones.
L-037កែមួយផ្នែកNothing re-checks during extraction. `backup.rs:957-960` limits the bytes written only to the global 16 GiB, not to the declared total (or per-entry size). An archive that understates its sizes passes the free-space check and can still write up to 16 GiB. The finding asked to "check again in extract". The `%TEMP%` upload copy is not pre-checked (the ledger says so).
L-041កែមួយផ្នែក(1) A clock ahead of the certificate's date returns `Refused::Certificate` (`manifest.rs:152-153`), which does not set the flag, so the main "PC clock wrong" case is still silent. (2) The flag is one global last-write-wins value: any other channel that verifies clears it (`mod.rs:579`). (3) The telemetry event that "what to do" asked for was not added; the ledger skipped it on purpose.
L-052កែមួយផ្នែកcontent-visibility is put on the wrong rule: commit 34e66c1b put it at `components/shell/setup/page/SetupBody.css:492-494`, inside `@container (max-width: 720px) { .sp-table.is-files .sp-table-head, .sp-table.is-files .sp-row {...} }`. It reaches only the Files table at narrow width (and its header), never the Content tab's rows (`ContentRow.tsx:100` `.sp-row` in a table that is not `is-files`). The 300-mod profile was never measured.
L-059កែមួយផ្នែកThe X button still does not guard a restore, modpack or install that is running. `game/launcher_window.rs` CloseRequested guards only game-file moves and running games. The ledger leaves this unbuilt ("after tracing backup"). A close within 1 s of the last key loses that second.
L-065កែមួយផ្នែកThe setup Logs tab's "Copy log" still copies raw text: `components/shell/setup/page/LogsTab.tsx:477-479` uses `lines.map(l => l.text).join("\n")`, with no `shareLog`. Its lines come from `setup_log_read`, which applies only `logs::censor` (`setup_data/logs.rs:119,180-188`: token, xuid, JWT, home). Other people's `[CHAT]` and IPv4 addresses still reach the clipboard there. The finding named this tab ("ដូចគ្នាក្នុង Logs tab").
L-066កែមួយផ្នែកSuspected, not run: on the payment result (paying → done), `abaShown` flips in the same commit, and the later effect at `PurchaseDialog.tsx:560-564` calls `dialogRef.focus()` after the step effect focused the heading. Focus lands on the dialog name, which is the original scenario. The `role=status` div mounts with its content already in it, which screen readers often do not announce. No test covers the transition from ABA to the result.
L-071កែមួយផ្នែកThe controls still use native `disabled` (LogView.tsx:153, SetupPicker.tsx:288, SkinPreviewPanel.tsx:375, SupportChatWindow.tsx:1553, ShopPage.tsx:139), so Tab skips them. A keyboard-only user still never hears the reason; only a screen reader in browse mode does. The test itself asserts `toBeDisabled()`. The fix asked for `aria-disabled` plus `aria-describedby`, or text shown next to the control; Shop is the only one with visible text (the "not on sale" price). NVDA was not run.
L-080កែមួយផ្នែកNo test covers the read-again guard (useSetupContent.ts:131-135, the loop that once ran forever). The fix named it first. The tauri-driver smoke test is put off on purpose. MyData and useLaunchSetupEvent still have no tests.
L-085កែមួយផ្នែកStill checks with `chrono::Utc::now()` (mod.rs:577), with no `bootstrap::server_now`, so a wrong PC clock still cannot be told apart from an old list. An expired certificate returns `Refused::Certificate` (manifest.rs:152-153), not `Expired`, so `saw_expired` stays false and the player still reads "not released yet". The Mazer Loader side (mod repo) is not done; the ledger I13 row says so too.
L-086កែមួយផ្នែកThe finding's own case, "or cert expired", is not covered: an expired cert gives `Refused::Certificate` (manifest.rs:152-153), so `saw_expired` is false and the kill-switch is skipped. Nothing tests manifest expired plus `holds.blocked` end to end. The launcher's own blocks are still skipped when its manifest is refused (launcher.rs:268 returns before `holds` at :275).
L-098កែមួយផ្នែកNo line cap and no clip: `split` reads a line of any length into memory, and `ended.lines.join` (:781) goes into the error message unclipped. The fix asked for `launch::read_line_capped` (launch.rs:581) plus a clip.
L-102កែមួយផ្នែកThe fix asked for: exit 0 → clean, crashed → crash, else → killed. A STOP is now sent as `clean`, and `killed` (registered at telemetry.rs:90) is still never sent. So Diagnostics cannot tell a stop from a clean exit, and nothing tests the telemetry mapping itself.
L-108កែមួយផ្នែកStill runs on the async task (engine.rs:1930, :1945; not `spawn_blocking`), so it blocks a tokio worker for up to 10 s. `kill_tree`'s `taskkill.status()` (launch.rs:666-672) has no time limit. hooks.rs:278-280 and :284-286, named in the finding, still call `child.wait()` with no deadline. No "game won't close" message EN/KM.
L-115កែមួយផ្នែកThree of the four stale comments the finding confirmed are still in the code: session_cache.rs:106-107 ("The refresh token is the one secret this launcher keeps at rest"), oauth.rs:275 ("The login window shares the app's WebView2 profile", yet login_window.rs:110 sets `incognito(true)`), and model.rs:192 ("PREMIUM badge unforgeable", with no note that accounts.json has no integrity). The ledger proof grepped only credentials.rs.
L-121កែមួយផ្នែកdevice.rs:8 still says "a refresh token copied off the disk is useless without the key", which is false for the software fallback (its PKCS#8 sits in the same credential store, :14-17). The fix named lines 6-8.
L-128កែមួយផ្នែកA 200 whose body is not JSON and not labelled HTML (wrong or missing content-type, cut short) is still cached. fabric.rs:181-183 hands it back as is, with no fresh fetch, for the 30-day TTL. The asked fix (refetch when the profile is not JSON, as at :201-205) was not done.
L-133កែមួយផ្នែកThe refusal is the generic `damaged()` (mrpack.rs:241), not the clear "file too large" message the fix asked for.
L-137កែមួយផ្នែក`prune` (cache.rs:396-401): a future mtime makes `duration_since` fail, `unwrap_or_default()` gives 0, and the entry is never pruned until real time catches up. The fix named prune. Disk-space only, low.
L-139កែមួយផ្នែកinstances/modpack.rs still exists: it maps every other `Network` error, 404 included, to `offline()` (:513). The ledger is wrong to say "modpack.rs no longer exists". library.rs:663 still maps a 404 on the version lookup to the check-internet text. No test for `download_failed_because`.
L-142កែមួយផ្នែកIPv6 and host names (for example `Connecting to friend.ddns.net`) are still sent; a `ponytail:` note at logs.rs:224 puts them off on purpose. The fix asked for IPv4 and IPv6.
L-153កែមួយផ្នែកHover keeps the 16 ms timer running with `moving=true`, and `RedrawWindow(window, RDW_INVALIDATE)` redraws the whole window (:1603-1617). This happens whatever the motion setting is, so a cursor resting on Cancel during a download over RDP still redraws at about 60 fps. CPU over RDP is not measured (ledger says so).
L-159កែមួយផ្នែកFull jar scans still run on async threads: `updates/mod.rs:887` (`before_play`, `mazer_mod_jars` before the timeout), `:618` (`withdraw_blocked`, async), and `jar_version` at :949. Each scan blocks a tokio worker while it opens every jar.
L-161កែមួយផ្នែកThe folder error on the Options page (Network or NotWritable, drawn at ui.rs:2314-2324) is not given to MSAA, so Next is unavailable with no reason heard. No real Narrator or NVDA run (ledger says "untested").
L-162កែមួយផ្នែកFocus is not returned after a successful switch or an outside click: `closeSwitcher()` at :80 makes the panel inert and focus drops to body. No test does Tab to a row, then Enter, then checks the switch.
L-176កែមួយផ្នែក"Focus main on tab change" is not done: `selectTab` (`AppShell.tsx:159-171`) moves no focus, and `<main>` (:454) has no tabIndex or ref.
L-180កែមួយផ្នែកThe "N files" summary in FilesTab is not done: `FilesTab.tsx:267-269` still joins every failure line. No screenshot with 50 rows.
L-183កែមួយផ្នែកNo Retry button in SaveBadge, which "what to do" asks for. While the dialog is open nothing retries. If the try on close also fails, it is lost silently.
L-207កែមួយផ្នែកThe stutter can persist another way: each 5 s retry still calls `invoke("support_send", {files})` (`api.ts:173-174`), so up to about 107 MB of base64 is serialized to JSON and sent over IPC each round while offline. There is still no backoff and no offline check before sending.
L-219កែមួយផ្នែក`PendingOrderDialog.tsx:73-77` drops the status and `:148` renders `<Result>` without `status`. An order checked from the pending list that settles PAID or DELIVERING still says "purchase is complete". That is the main late-payment path

ក្រុម C1a: ចំណុចខ្សោយថ្មី (អត្ថបទ verifier)
### from part A

- `internal/cosmetics/http.go:160` + `internal/cosmetics/skin.go:222`: DELETE /v1/me/skin with no skin still publishes Forget on the bus and runs ProfileChanged fan-out on every node; bounded to 20/h/user now. Low, confirmed by reading.
- `internal/insights/pages.go:573` (and other Panel reads on `r.pool`): `count(*)/min/max` over whole raw tables runs under the role's 10 s transaction_timeout, so at scale the Panel gets a 500 (FATAL) instead of a 503; the Panel half of C-015 was not addressed. Low-medium, suspected (scale-dependent).
- `docs/playbooks/core-down.en.md:48-50` §4 Tunnel still tells the owner to restart host `cloudflared-mazer@1/@2`, while tunnels now run inside mazerd per node (`cmd/mazerd/tunnels.go:22`, ADR 0088 #11). Low, suspected stale (true only for hosts still on cloudflared.sh).
- `docs/playbooks/core-down.en.md:42`: restore step says "raise it above their floor as promote-safe does" with no command; `mazerctl db raise-epoch <n> --yes` is the tool. Low, confirmed.

### from part B

1. `internal/moderation/blocks.go:195-196` vs `:193-194,240-242`: a stale-triggered `go readBlocks` that started before AddBlock committed can finish after the forced read from `forget` and put back the older list. The new block then goes unenforced on this node for up to 30 s. Low, suspected.
2. `internal/audit/audit.go:66`: `SET LOCAL lock_timeout='2s'` stays in force for the rest of the caller's transaction. Every statement after Record in the same tx (row locks, FOR UPDATE) silently gets a 2 s lock timeout. Low, confirmed by reading.
3. `internal/audit/audit.go:59-71`: in a tx that records a staff row and then a `Local: true` row, the last `SET LOCAL synchronous_commit` wins (`local`). The staff row's commit then does not wait for the replica, against LB-1.10. Low, suspected (needs a caller that mixes both).
4. `internal/admin/handlers.go:121-127`: `chainItems` holds `s.chain.mu` for the whole `audit.Verify`. A slow Verify blocks every Panel tab's Attention call and the alert loop on that node for its full duration. Low/medium, confirmed by reading.
5. `internal/audit/lint_test.go:18`: the regex `[^}]*` stops at the first `}`, and the lint skips Detail maps built in variables (settings.go:263, nodes.go `detail` args). The guard is weaker than the ledger implies. Low, confirmed.

### from part C

1. internal/admin/access.go:175-181. While a key fetch is running (`a.fetching`), every other request with the new kid gets `errAccess` "unknown key" (a 401), not the 503 used for unreadable keys (C-349). During a real Cloudflare rotation, the owner's parallel Panel requests can be read as signed out. Severity low, suspected.
2. proto/mazer/v1/gateway.proto:10-12. The header contradicts itself about the launcher opening sockets (see C-059). Severity low, confirmed.
3. internal/gateway/watch.go:63-69. The premium per-address ceiling (`pip:`, limit.go:144-146) is still split by node count. Many premium players behind one NAT (a school or internet cafe), spread over N nodes, each get 1/N of the shared ceiling. This is the C-057 effect in another place. Severity low, suspected (not measured).
4. internal/admin/database.go:114-127. `auditLater` retries forever with no cap or dedup, one goroutine per promote, so a long DB outage piles up WARN lines every minute per pending row. Severity low, confirmed by reading.

### from part D

1. cmd/mazerd/cluster.go:802-807 with internal/cluster/cluster.go:726-730. Severity low, suspected. When a drain ends, `SetState(Drained)` runs an unconditional `UPDATE nodes SET state=$3 WHERE name AND instance`. If StopUpdate (or a staff Activate) sets 'active' while the drain goroutine is past its last ctx check, the node writes 'drained' over 'active' and leaves DrainFile, so capacity is lost silently again (the C-073 symptom). The dctx cancel only takes effect once the node hears Active on a heartbeat. Fix idea: `AND state = 'draining'` in that UPDATE.
2. cmd/mazerd/cluster.go:741-742 with internal/gateway/server.go:1126-1132. Severity low, confirmed by reading. The backstop closes stale pairs with `Close(user, device)`, and Close with a device matches `c.device` only. So when one premium record leaves a device (the C-076 unlink case), the backstop also closes that device's other, still-valid records. `ClosePair` (server.go:1137) exists for this case and is not used. They can reconnect, so this is a one-off disconnect, not a security problem.
3. cmd/mazerd/cluster.go:992-994. Severity low, confirmed. A `staleSessions` query error is swallowed with no log or metric, so the C-005/C-076 backstop can fail every round without anyone seeing it.

### from part E

1. cmd/mazerd/alerts.go:96-103 with internal/alert/alert.go:225-226: the Telegram secret lookups share the 15 s send ctx, so on a hung (not refusing) DB every alert fails to send, and every tick retries the same way. Severity medium. Confirmed by reading (pgx honours the ctx deadline; the HTTP request then gets an expired ctx); not run.
2. internal/status/status.go:95-96: the 5 s cache is filled with the caller's request ctx. A client that cancels mid-read can make `failing` report errors, and that "degraded" answer is then served to everyone for 5 s. While the DB hangs, every /v1/status request also queues on `a.mu`. Severity low. Suspected.
3. internal/alert/alert.go:113-117: a check that ignores its ctx leaves one goroutine behind per tick (one a minute for each hung check) until the DB returns. Severity low. Suspected.
4. cmd/mazerctl/setupfile.go:101-104: the draft marker is deleted before latest.json is written (the reverse of the launcher order in manifest.go). This is the race window behind the C-095 Setup gap. Severity low. Confirmed by reading.
ក្រុម C1b: ចំណុចខ្សោយថ្មី (អត្ថបទ verifier)
1. **cmd/mazerctl/release.go:205-217 and :94-101: a failed tag gets stuck (low, suspected from reading).** If `git commit` succeeds and `git tag` fails, a rerun builds from the new HEAD. The embedded commit and release.json then differ from the bytes already published, and the immutable Put refuses for ever. The only way out is to delete R2 objects by hand. Fix: on rerun, if core/<version>/release.json exists with the same version, verify it against the code commit (HEAD~1 when HEAD is the chore commit) instead of rebuilding.
2. **internal/downloads/http.go:111, :116: raw path in a metric label (medium, suspected from reading).** `r.Pattern = r.URL.Path + " (off)"` / `" (refused)"` puts the path into the label. The guard runs before the router (routes.go:173), so random `/v1/releases/<x>` paths create unbounded metric series. This is the C-139 flaw in another place.
3. **cmd/mazerctl/dbpromote.go:225 and ctlpool.go:52-82: the epoch fence misses the first stale connection (medium, confirmed by reading).** Promote never records the new db_epoch in ctlEpochFile, so the PC's fence against an old primary works only after the PC has reached the new primary once. Same root as the C-125 gap.
4. **cmd/mazerctl/rotate.go:122: wrong rerun message (low, confirmed by reading).** "Run the same command again: it takes the key already set" is false after a phase-2 failure: NEXT has been emptied, so a rerun makes a new key. Harmless but misleading in an emergency.
5. **cmd/mazerctl/cfsetup.go:202: stale step label (low, confirmed).** Step 4 still prints "for <email> alone", which contradicts the keep-everyone policy.
6. **internal/ads/ads.go:166-172: false audit on take-back (low, confirmed by reading).** The SetNoAds take-back ignores TakeGrant's result and audits `ads.no_ads_revoke` even when nothing was taken. This is the C-157 bug in a sibling path.
7. **cmd/mazerd/audit_c_test.go:60: stale test exemption (low, confirmed).** `POST /v1/me/session-end` is still exempt from the "every write has a rate limit" test, which would hide removal of routes.go:474.
8. **internal/insights/rollup.go:158: unfiltered telemetry versions (low, confirmed).** Telemetry versions go into version_daily with no filter and are kept for ever (C-154 sibling).
9. **deploy/host/db-agent.sh:105-116: unchecked ALLOW_FROM (low, suspected).** ALLOW_FROM goes into ufw/nft and firewall.allow without an IP check; its format differs from firewall-live's (`ip:port`).
10. **internal/platform/db/db.go:333-350: dropInvalidIndexes is too broad (low, suspected).** It drops every invalid index in the database, including one from an operator's REINDEX CONCURRENTLY in progress.
11. **internal/analytics/rollup.go:79-83: rollup rows can grow (low, suspected).** The top-N rollup never deletes rows that fell out of the top N, so a bucket can grow past N over reruns.
12. **.github/workflows/ci.yml:24: unpinned image (low, confirmed).** The `postgres2` service image `postgres:17` is not pinned by digest, unlike the first service.
13. **Core repo: leftover worktrees (low, confirmed).** `.claude/worktrees/proof` and `.claude/worktrees/r-core-2` still exist after merge, against the owner's memory rule.
ក្រុម C2a: ចំណុចខ្សោយថ្មី (អត្ថបទ verifier)
- docs/playbooks/bad-release.en.md:32 and km:32: "Roll back → the row → **Offered**". The Panel menu item is "Lift the hold" (Panel pages.ts:1036). Low, confirmed (this is the C-186 gap).
- Panel src/i18n/locales/en/common.ts:101 and km:105 `offlineHelp`: no fallback path named. Low, confirmed (this is the C-195 gap).
- api/openapi.yaml:3090-3092: the security-events description lists 9 domains, but code (insights.go:24) has 16. Low, confirmed.
- internal/moderation/reports.go:59 `cleanText`: refuses only NUL and bad UTF-8. A report's note and target_name can still carry bidi or control characters, which the finding said can mislead staff. settings.go:291 `hidden` already exists and could be reused. Low, confirmed.
- deploy/host/db-replica.sh:598-622: deny ends sessions by the denied IP only. A Core node on the same host as the DB reaches it from the 172.x bridge and keeps its sessions, and the bridge hba line stays. Low, suspected.
- Floor kill switch latency: releases/floor.go:22 (30 s cache) plus the 30 s backstop means up to about 60 s, while bad-release.en.md says "Within 30 seconds". Low, suspected (backstop interval taken from comments).
- internal/admin/attention.go:341: a manifest missing from Live gives no attention item, so a deleted stable.json is silent. Low, confirmed.
- internal/sentinel/sentinel.go:161: an out-of-range baseline is reported as `unknown_signal`, a misleading message. Info, confirmed.
- internal/nodeid/server.go:309-330 with cmd/mazerd/nodes.go:56: Pterodactyl HTTP runs while Renew's transaction (nonce + node row) is open, plus a second advisory transaction, so one renew holds two pool connections up to 10 s (REL-2 class). Low, suspected.
- internal/gateway/cluster.go:216-220: dropping `ver` entries removes the stale-message guard for those UUIDs. A message later than the last 4096 could re-apply an old "up". Info, suspected.
ក្រុម C2b: ចំណុចខ្សោយថ្មី (អត្ថបទ verifier)
1. **internal/moderation/sanctions.go:107 and :143.** Ban and Lift reasons are measured with `len(reason) > 500`, which counts bytes. The message says "500 characters", and the Panel (Panel src/features/safety/sanctions.tsx:214,314) uses `maxLength={500}` characters. So a Khmer ban or lift reason over about 166 characters gets a 400. This is the same bug as C-358, which was fixed only in blocks.go. Low. Confirmed by reading the code.
2. **cmd/mazerd/routes.go:101 and :259.** The `(unavailable)` and `(blocked)` labels start with the raw `r.Method`. net/http accepts any method token, so random methods sent while the node is down, or from a blocked address, add one metrics series each. This is C-366's mechanism through the method instead of the path. Medium if Cloudflare forwards custom methods through the tunnel. Suspected: I did not check whether Cloudflare passes them. A fix is to map the method to a known set or "OTHER".
3. **internal/sentinel/sentinel.go:300.** If the baseline batch write fails, `judge` returns before act and before `revert`. A time-boxed registration close can then stay past its time while that write keeps failing. It is a sibling of C-314, but narrower, since revert needs the DB too. Low. Confirmed by reading the code.
4. **internal/sentinel/sentinel.go:331-337.** A lasting registration surge writes a new `proposal` incident plus an audit row every minute; only notices merge. This is listed under C-326 as PARTIAL. Low-medium. Confirmed by reading the code.
5. **internal/platform/objstore/objstore.go:262-263.** An immutable Put that gets 412, then 404 on the re-check, returns nil with nothing stored. Low. Suspected (needs a delete between the two calls).
6. **deploy/host/node-setup.sh:26 and core-node.sh:14.** `*live-restore*` matches `"live-restore": false`, so an existing file that turns it off is left that way. Low. Confirmed by reading the code.
7. **migrations/lint_test.go:171.** ADD CHECK, UNIQUE or FOREIGN KEY without the CONSTRAINT keyword, and inline `REFERENCES` on ADD COLUMN, pass the new-file lint. Low. Confirmed by reading the regex.
8. **deploy/host/mesh-peers.sh.** There is no IPv6 (ip6tables) rule. `node remove` does not drop the removed machine from the peer list. Low. Suspected.
9. **Process note.** `.claude/worktrees/proof` (detached) and `.claude/worktrees/r-core-2` (branch r-core-2) still exist next to master, while project memory says worktrees are removed after merge. Another session may still be using them. Not code.
ក្រុម L1a: ចំណុចខ្សោយថ្មី (អត្ថបទ verifier)
1. `src/i18n/locales/en/launch.ts:29` and `km/launch.ts:28`: `closeAskBody` says "It stops at once, without saving. Anything since the last save is lost." Since L-022 the launcher asks the game to close and waits 15 s, so the world normally saves. The text scares players off a safe action and is wrong. The comments `LaunchButton.tsx:226` and `SetupActions.tsx:100` ("kills the game outright") are stale for the same reason. Low, confirmed.

The header is never off screen, so the rule does nothing; Content rows get nothing. Low, confirmed (this is the L-052 gap).

4. `src/components/store/PurchaseDialog.tsx:560-564` against `:523-532`: the order of the focus effects on paying → done (the L-066 gap). Medium (a11y on the payment result), suspected. 5. `src-tauri/src/instances/backup.rs:957-960`: extraction caps only at the global 16 GiB, not at the declared size of each entry or the declared total, so the free-space pre-check (`:217`) can be bypassed by an archive that understates its sizes. Low, confirmed (the L-037 gap).
6. `src-tauri/src/updates/manifest.rs:152-153` with `updates/mod.rs:586`: an expired certificate (a clock far ahead) is `Refused::Certificate` and is never reported to About. Low, confirmed (the L-041 gap).
7. `src-tauri/src/lib.rs:725`: the Tester edition's WebView2 profile (`tester/webview`) is outside `storage/mod.rs:16` `WEBVIEW_DIRS`, so Remove everything and a shared-PC start do not wipe it. Low, confirmed.
8. `src-tauri/src/game/crash_cause.rs` / `engine.rs:851`: hs_err censoring runs only when a game ends; there is no start-up pass (the L-019 gap). Medium (token on disk), confirmed.
ក្រុម L1b: ចំណុចខ្សោយថ្មី (អត្ថបទ verifier)
1. **engine.rs:1990** `setup_java_args` (`$INST_JAVA_ARGS` for hooks) always adds `-Xms1024M` next to the player's own `-Xmx512M`, the same conflict L-093 fixed in args.rs. A hook that starts a JVM with it is refused. Low, confirmed by reading.
2. **updates/manifest.rs:152-153** An expired certificate is reported as `Refused::Certificate`, not `Expired`. This blocks both the L-085 message and the L-086 kill-switch path. Medium (the kill-switch is lost exactly when the signing chain lapses). Confirmed by reading.

ក្រុម PWa: ចំណុចខ្សោយថ្មី (អត្ថបទ verifier)
1. **Attention kinds missing in the Panel** (`src/features/attention/routes.ts`, `index.tsx` Sentence, `routes.test.ts:20-38`). Severity medium, confirmed. `ads_bucket_unsafe`, `audit_head_stale` and `node_secrets_exposed` are critical; `audit_head_unreadable` is a warning. All 4 show as a raw code with only "Check again", in both languages. `src/api/schema.gen.ts` is behind Core `api/openapi.yaml`. Fix: run `pnpm gen:api`, then build the test's list from the generated union instead of by hand.
2. **Stale op after verification** (`src/features/nodes/database.tsx:105-108`). Severity low, confirmed by reading. `save(null)` clears storage but not the `incident` state. Until reload, the page still offers "Carry on <old op>", and `run()` (:136-146) reuses the old op for the same replica name. The agent then refuses it ("promoted by another op"); the refusal is now explained.
3. **Sending a Duplicate wipes the draft** (`composer.tsx:293-301`). Severity low, confirmed. See P-057.
4. **Focus outlines may break owner rule 8** (`src/features/audit/index.tsx:338`, also `players/player.tsx:282`). Severity low, suspected. The new expand button has `focus-visible:outline-2`, and the player row has `focus-visible:ring-[3px]`. Rule 8 says to ask the owner before adding a keyboard-focus ring. I did not check whether the owner approved this (13148fe says "visible field focus").
5. **Commit parser drift** (`scripts/release/bump.mjs:24` vs `impact.mjs:12,64`). Severity low, confirmed. The changelog accepts `BREAKING CHANGE:` with no space and trims the subject; impact needs `': '` and does not trim. A body `BREAKING CHANGE:x` is breaking in the changelog but not in the version pick.
6. **Baseline row says None when unknown** (`src/features/settings/index.tsx:170`). Severity low, confirmed. It shows `None` when the baseline query failed. See P-026.
7. **Failed pill still below AA** (`src/features/releases/logic.ts:399`). Severity low, confirmed. The `failed` pill is still `bg-brand/20 text-brand` (about 4.15:1).
ក្រុម PWb: ចំណុចខ្សោយថ្មី (អត្ថបទ verifier)
1. **Website `lib/structured-data.ts:117-120` (and `legalName` at :70).** The public JSON-LD `copyrightHolder` lists the organizations "MAZER-CLIENT" and "MAZER-CLUB". Owner rule 5 says copyright must name GoldenIQ only. Medium (owner rule). Confirmed. Ask the owner before changing it.
2. **Website commit 8f1ccc6.** Its message is "wip(audit): unfinished session work, not verified, do not merge as is", yet it is on `master` and is the cited fix for W-006, W-007, W-011, W-021, W-022 and W-023. The code I read is correct and tested, but the history says it was merged unverified. Low (process). Confirmed.
3. **Panel `i18n/locales/en/system.ts:13-14`, `km/system.ts:13-14`.** `switches.configHelp` still says Partner servers changes every setting. This is the open part of P-060. Low. Confirmed.
4. **Panel `i18n/locales/en/pages.ts:786-789` (and KM).** `players.banBody`, `unbanTitle`, `unbanBody` and `unbannedToast` have no caller. More dead keys, of the P-075 kind. Low. Suspected (grep only).
5. **Core `internal/admin/attention.go:362`.** `days` truncates toward 0, so for up to 24 h after a manifest expires the Panel calls it "0 days left" instead of "expired". Low. Confirmed by reading.
6. **Panel `features/attention/routes.ts:35-36`.** `manifest_expiring` always links to `/releases`, even when `params.product` is the mod, which has its own page (ADR 0087). Low. Suspected: I did not check whether Core's `downloads.Channels` includes mod channels.
7. **Website `api/report-theft/route.ts:125`.** The full `Referer` (`page`) goes to Discord. A copy controls its own Referrer-Policy, so this can include a visitor's query string. Low. Suspected.
8. **Website `lib/ip-files.test.ts:49-52`.** The SHA-256 of a single name word can be reversed by dictionary. Low. Confirmed by design.
9. **Panel `components/owner-only.tsx:21`.** The comment claims the reason opens on tap, but Radix Tooltip does not open on tap. Low. Confirmed.
10. **Website `scripts/legal/privacy-from-core.test.mjs:63`.** The copy check skips when Core is not checked out next to the site, so CI on Cloudflare never catches policy drift. Low. Confirmed.

06ផ្លូវជួសជុលតាមតក្កវិទ្យា

លំដាប់តាមច្បាប់តែមួយ: ឈប់អ្វីដែលបាត់ហើយយកវិញមិនបានមុន → អ្វីអ្នកក្រៅប៉ះបាន → អ្វីរារាំងការស្ដារ → នៅសល់។ ដំណាក់ក្រោយពឹងដំណាក់មុន: ឧ. drill key លេចគ្មានន័យ បើ alert មិនទាន់ដើរ។ ពេលវេលាជាការប៉ាន់ស្មានសម្រាប់ session AI + ម្ចាស់ម្នាក់។

ដំណាក់ 0 — ថ្ងៃនេះ, ភាគច្រើនជាការកំណត់

អ្វីដែលបាត់ហើយយកវិញមិនបាន អ្វីអ្នកក្រៅប៉ះបានឥឡូវ និងការដឹងថាម៉ាស៊ីននៅស្អាតឬអត់។

  • ✓ Triage X-018 អានតែរួច: មិនឃើញសញ្ញា តែមិនបញ្ជាក់ថាស្អាត; ម្ចាស់សម្រេចលើ rebuild។
  • បន្ត domain + auto-renew: mazerclub.app (2026-11-23), mazersmp.com (12-21), mazerclub.net (12-22), mazer.club (12-25) (X-009, X-025)។
  • ✓ SSH key-only លើ BOX1/BOX3/node1 (X-001) រួច 11-05។
  • 2FA admin golden + បង្ខំ 2FA (X-014): ម្ចាស់។ ✓ chmod Wings config, .env (X-004, X-013) រួច។
  • ដក key root ឆ្លងម៉ាស៊ីន, passphrase/hardware key លើ PC (X-010, X-011) ក្រោយផ្ទៀងផ្លូវចូលបម្រុង។
  • ✓ renew task (X-017) រួច។ O8 Bitwarden; Telegram + probe ខាងក្រៅ + កាត់ noise alert (X-012): នៅសល់។
  • ពិនិត្យបន្ទាន់: disk BOX1 (X-003), memory limit/OOM (X-007), version panel/Wings (X-015)។ ✓ DNS ព្យួរ X-016 រួច; X-032 រង់ចាំម្ចាស់។

ច្រកចេញ: បង្ហាញ sshd -T និង login ថ្មីលើម៉ាស៊ីនទាំង ៤ ជាមួយផ្លូវបម្រុងនៅដើរ; សាក MFA + recovery; alert ពីខាងក្រៅដល់ទូរស័ព្ទពេលម៉ាស៊ីនដែលត្រូវតាមដានបិទ; លទ្ធផល triage កត់ក្នុង worklog។

ដំណាក់ 1 — សប្ដាហ៍ទី 1: ស្ដារបានមុន, DoS, ផ្ទៃសាធារណៈ

មុនប្ដូរ credential ឬ DB ត្រូវដឹងថាស្ដារបាន។ បន្ទាប់ចំណុចដែលអ្នកណាក៏វាយបានដោយគ្មាន account។

  • Restore មួយលើម៉ាស៊ីនស្អាតពី Bitwarden តែ មុនការប្ដូរដែលប៉ះ DB ឬ key។
  • C-001 heartbeat memory DoS; C-017 ពិដាន limiter; C-013 idempotency មុន route; C-019 Worker quota។
  • ចេញ pack ថ្មីដែលមាន 52c1ef9 (0.27.0 ផ្ទាល់មិនទាន់មាន)។
  • R2 bucket lock + key គ្មាន delete (X-005); Access IdP + MFA + session ខ្លី (X-002)។
  • កាត់ផ្លូវ game → DB/Core ដោយ firewall (X-006, C-020); isolation ពេញនៅដំណាក់ 3។
  • Triage កុមារ/ឯកជនភាព: L-008 និងអ្វីដែលគួរបិទបណ្ដោះអាសន្នរហូតពិនិត្យរួច។

ច្រកចេញ: restore ជោគជ័យមានពេលវាស់; memory និងចំនួន key limiter មានដែនក្រោម request វាយប្រហារលើ staging; pack ផ្ទាល់មាន fix; credential production លុប backup ដែលជាប់ retention មិនបាន។

ដំណាក់ 2 — សប្ដាហ៍ទី 2–3: Key និងអត្តសញ្ញាណ

ត្រូវធ្វើមុនចេញ ព្រោះក្រោយ client ចែករួច កែពិបាក។

  • OPS-1 ញែក key; L-001, L-005 ដក cert/rotate root; C-011, C-012 កុំចុះហត្ថលេខាអ្វីមិនបានផ្ទៀង; C-008, C-009 កុំអះអាងថាបាន reinstall។
  • SEC-1, C-002, C-004, C-023 revoke និង rotate ដើរពិត។
  • C-003/C-029 ដក device បាន; L-009 token record ត្រូវ; LAU-1, L-002, L-003, M-003 ព្រំដែន token/ពាក្យសម្ងាត់។

ច្រកចេញ: បង្ហាញថា key, token, cert, device session ចាស់ fail គ្រប់ verifier ក្រោយពេលផ្សព្វផ្សាយ; credential ថ្មី និង rollback ដើរ; drill “key លេច” តាម playbook ពេញលើ staging។

ដំណាក់ 3 — សប្ដាហ៍ទី 3–4: ស្ដារបានពិត

ប្រព័ន្ធដែលស្ដារមិនបាន គឺគ្មានសុវត្ថិភាពទោះការពារល្អ។

  • C-016, C-088, P-004, C-022, C-092, OPS-4; X-008 sync commit លើ node1 ខ្សោយ។
  • Postmortem IR-2026-08-05 + DB host ស្អាត (X-018)។
  • បំបែក network Core ពី game ពេញ (X-006); firewall ដូចគ្នាលើម៉ាស៊ីនទាំង ៤ (X-021)។

ច្រកចេញ: សាកបាត់ primary និងបាត់ standby ដាច់ដោយឡែក; fence primary ចាស់; ពិនិត្យ integrity និង write ដែល ack រួចថាបាត់ឬអត់; ជាប់ RTO/RPO កំណត់ទុកមុន; ស្ដារមិនពឹង secret នៅលើម៉ាស៊ីនដែលស្លាប់។

ដំណាក់ 4 — ខែទី 2: ឯកជនភាព និងច្បាប់

09សេនារីយ៉ូដេញដោលតាមមុខងារ

Reviewer គ្រប់រូបត្រូវរត់សេនារីយ៉ូ S1–S15 លើមុខងារ។ លេខ = ចំនួនចំណុចដែលសេនារីយ៉ូនោះបង្ហាញឲ្យឃើញ។ “·” មិនមានន័យថាមានសុវត្ថិភាពទេ គឺគ្រាន់តែគ្មានចំណុចកត់។ Reviewer កត់ផ្លូវសំខាន់ដែលពិនិត្យហើយឃើញត្រឹមត្រូវ 317 ផ្លូវ។

និយមន័យ

  • S1 ហៅដោយគ្មាន auth រំលង UI
  • S2 A ប្រើ object របស់ B
  • S3 ត្រូវ ban/revoke តែ socket/token នៅ
  • S4 Replay, ស្ទួន, ច្រាសលំដាប់, ព្រមគ្នា
  • S5 Input ធំ/ខូច/compressed/Unicode
  • S6 អ្នកវាយកាន់ URL, path, archive, server, asset
  • S7 Crash ចន្លោះ write និង side effect
  • S8 Dependency timeout/ផ្នែកខ្លះ/retry
  • S9 ដាច់ហើយរាប់ពាន់ reconnect
  • S10 Disk, memory, FD, DB, quota អស់
  • S11 Client/service ចាស់+ថ្មីរួមគ្នា
  • S12 នាឡិកា, expiry, rotate, cache ចាស់
  • S13 Credential ទាបមួយត្រូវលួច: ទៅដល់ណា
  • S14 Host/DB primary បាត់
  • S15 ម្ចាស់មិននៅ: រកឃើញ/ទប់/ស្ដារបានទេ

internal/identity/records.go:155 · core · security · confirmed · ទំហំ M · session A · S3 S13 S15 S2
លក្ខខណ្ឌ
អ្នកវាយប្រហារកាន់ Minecraft access token របស់ជនរងគ្រោះមួយភ្លែត (mod អាក្រក់, មិត្តប្រើ PC, កូនក្មេងចូលលើ PC អ្នកដទៃ) ឬបានលួច file key ពី config mod
សេនារីយ៉ូ
អ្នកវាយប្រហារ register key ថ្មី → GET premium challenge → joinServer → POST /v1/me/identities/premium → linkRecord សរសេរ device_players ជារៀងរហូត។ ចាប់ពីនេះ Login(player)/Refresh មិនសួរ Mojang ម្ដងទៀតទេ (ADR 0014 proof តែម្ដង); refresh រំកិល 60 ថ្ងៃគ្មានកំណត់។ Token មានអំណាចលើ record ទាំងមូល: PUT skin/loadout, redeem, seal, GET /v1/me/export។ ជនរងគ្រោះប្ដូរពាក្យសម្ងាត់ Microsoft ក៏មិនកាត់។ ជនរងគ្រោះដកមិនបាន: openapi គ្មាន /v1/me/devices; DELETE /v1/me/identities/{id} ដកតែ device របស់អ្នកហៅ (service.go:754); ListDevices អានតែ devices.user_id = record (queries.sql:90) ដូច្នេះ /v1/me បង្ហាញបញ្ជីទទេលើ record គ្មាន key។ Staff ក៏មិនឃើញ: Panel Player.Devices ប្រើ query ដដែល ហើយ AdminRevokeDevice ទាមទារ devices.user_id = record (queries.sql:187) ⇒ ត្រូវរកពី audit identity.premium_linked ដោយដៃ។ Notification Attached (cmd/mazerd/main.go:733) ប្រាប់ថា sign that device out in the launcher ហើយ refusal too_many_devices ថា sign one out first: ផ្លូវទាំងនោះមិនមាន។ ADR 0055 ចាត់ទុក ban key, MaxDevices, notification ជាការទប់: គ្មានមួយណាធ្វើការបានសម្រាប់ម្ចាស់
ឫសគល់
ADR 0055 ប្ដូរ key ពីម្ចាស់ទៅអ្នកធ្វើការជំនួស ប៉ុន្តែផ្លូវគ្រប់គ្រង (បញ្ជី/ដក) នៅតែគិតថា device មួយមាន user មួយ; device_players មិនត្រូវបានអានដោយ API ណាមួយ ហើយ proof Mojang មិនមានអាយុ
ដំណោះស្រាយដើម
(1) GET/DELETE /v1/me/devices លើ record អាន device_players (launcher scope) និង Panel + mazerctl ដូចគ្នា; (2) ដក device ពី record បដិសេធ tokens និងបិទ socket (DenyPair + Unlinked); (3) ឲ្យ proof មានអាយុ: device_players.proved_at ហើយ refresh លើ record ដែល proof ចាស់ជាង N ថ្ងៃត្រូវ proof ឡើងវិញ; (4) ជួសពាក្យ notification ឲ្យត្រូវនឹងផ្លូវពិត
ពិតឬអត់
ពិត: Minecraft token លួចម្ដង ឲ្យ key អ្នកវាយប្រហារធ្វើការជំនួស record បានជារៀងរហូត ហើយម្ចាស់ពិតមើលមិនឃើញ និងដកមិនបាន។ ADR ទទួលស្គាល់ហានិភ័យ តែការទប់ដែលវាពឹង មិនដើរសម្រាប់ម្ចាស់។
records.go:155 link never expires; service.go:342,462 check only actsFor; service.go:756 deletes the caller's device only; queries.sql:90,187 use devices.user_id; openapi has no /v1/me/devices; Panel needs audit lookup of home.
ចេតនា
អចេតនា (ADR 0055:78 counts ban key and notification as mitigations; main.go:733 advises a sign-out path that does not exist)
ធ្វើអ្វី
ត្រូវកែ: បន្ថែម query ListRecordDevices (device_players JOIN devices), GET និង DELETE /v1/me/devices (launcher scope) និង Panel + mazerctl; ពេលដក: DELETE device_players + RevokeFamily តាម (user,device) + DenyPair + Unlinked។ ជំនួសពាក្យ main.go:733។ ជំហានទីពីរ: proved_at ហើយ refresh ទាមទារ proof ថ្មីបើចាស់ជាង 90 ថ្ងៃ។ ពិនិត្យ: test ពីរ device ដែល device មួយដកមួយទៀត ហើយ refresh + socket ត្រូវបដិសេធ។
ផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់
បញ្ជាក់ឯករាជ្យ: records.go:105 link has no expiry; service.go:340,460 login/refresh check only actsFor, no Mojang; service.go:754 unlinks caller's device only; queries.sql:90,187 list/revoke use devices.user_id; no /v1/me/devices in openapi; main.go:733 advises a nonexistent path. Self-declared software key gets launcher scope (service.go:78).

លក្ខខណ្ឌ

សេនារីយ៉ូ
POST /v1/admin/nodes/enrollments {name, role:core} → ownerOnly ឆ្លង ហើយគ្មានការបញ្ជាក់ទីពីរ → ទទួល mzen_ token ជា plaintext ភ្លាម → enroll ដោយ key ខ្លួនឯងតាម /v1/nodes/* → ទទួល MAZER_DATABASE_URL + MAZER_MASTER_KEY + tunnel (openapi.yaml:3317-3318, nodeid/server.go:158) ⇒ ចេញ token ជំនួសអ្នកណាក៏បាន អាន secret ទាំងអស់។ ពីចំណុចនោះទៀត Owner ក៏ផ្ញើ broadcast/ad link phishing ទៅគ្រប់ launcher តាម bootstrap ដែលចុះហត្ថលេខា, ដក Owner ពិត (AdminDeleteStaff/PutStaff គ្មានការការពារ MAZER_OWNER_EMAIL), ប្ដូរ Telegram token ឲ្យ alert បាត់ (integrations.go:238)។ ផ្នែកមិនទាន់អាន: កូដ bundle ពេញ (R ផ្សេង)។
ឫសគល់

សេនារីយ៉ូ
ADR 0028 ដកការសួរអាយុដោយហេតុ៖ គ្មានផ្សាយ, presence តែ server ដដែល, មានប៊ូតុងបិទ social ហើយ policy និយាយថាមិនដឹងអាយុ។ ថ្ងៃនេះ៖ Google ads ជាផលិតផល (ADR 0057), presence សកល (ADR 0047:21; PRIV-3), appear offline ដក (ADR 0054), grep child|minor|parent ក្នុង privacy-policy.en.md និង launcher terms.en.md = 0។ deploy/ad-frame/slot.js:79 សម្គាល់ tagForChildDirectedTreatment ⇒ ប្រាប់ Google ថា child-directed តែ policy គ្មានអ្វី ហើយ collect persistent id (device key, UUID, telemetry default on: launcher settings/model.rs:150)។ COPPA តម្រូវមាតាបិតាមើល/លុបបាន តែ policy:218 'not deleted on request'; GDPR Art.8 ដូចគ្នា។ វិភាគបច្ចេកទេស មិនមែនយោបល់មេធាវី។
ឫសគល់
ADR ថ្មីនីមួយដកមូលដ្ឋាន ADR 0028 ដោយគ្មានអ្នកពិនិត្យឡើងវិញ; ADR 0028 នៅ Accepted។
ដំណោះស្រាយដើម
ADR ថ្មីសម្រាប់កុមារ (មិនសួរអាយុ): ឃ្លាក្នុង policy/terms, ផ្លូវមាតាបិតាសុំមើល/លុប (ភ្ជាប់ PRIV-5), presence តាម room (PRIV-3), diagnostics បិទលំនាំដើម ឬអនាមិក; មេធាវី។
ពិតឬអត់
ពិត: ការពិតបច្ចេកទេស៖ មូលដ្ឋាន ៣ របស់ ADR 0028 លែងមាន ហើយ policy គ្មានឃ្លាកុមារ។ COPPA/GDPR តម្រូវអ្វី ជាការសម្រេចរបស់មេធាវី មិនមែនកូដ។
ADR 0028:11 relies on no ads, same-server presence, social off. ADR 0057, 0047, 0054 removed all three. grep child/minor/parent in policy: 0. slot.js:71-75,103 sets child-directed. model.rs:150 diagnostics default on.
ចេតនា
មិនដឹង (ADR 0028 stays Accepted while ADR 0057, 0047, 0054 removed its premises; no paper trail reassessing it)
ធ្វើអ្វី
ម្ចាស់សម្រេច: សំណួរម្ចាស់៖ ព្រមសួរមេធាវីមុន R1 ថាតើត្រូវ (ក) ឃ្លាកុមារ + ផ្លូវមាតាបិតាសុំមើល/លុប, (ខ) បិទ ads/diagnostics លំនាំដើម, ឬ (គ) geo-limit? អនុសាសន៍៖ (ក) + ADR ថ្មីជំនួស 0028 ដោយមិនសួរអាយុ; house ads រហូតមានចម្លើយ។
ផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់
បញ្ជាក់ឯករាជ្យ: ADR 0028:11 relies on no ads, same-server presence, social off, yet stays Accepted; ADR 0057 adds ads, 0047 removes rooms, 0054 removes hiding. grep child/minor/parent in policy: 0; terms only 'no age'. slot.js sets child-directed in both ad branches; diagnostics true (model.rs). COPPA/GDPR conclusions need counsel.
ស្ថានភាព

internal/gateway/server.go:208 · core · security · confirmed · ទំហំ S · session C · S1 S10
លក្ខខណ្ឌ
អ្នកណាក៏បានពី internet, botnet IP ប៉ុន្មានរយ ឬ IPv6 /48 ច្រើន។ Compensating: Cloudflare 2,000/10 s ក្នុងមួយ IP មិនរារាំងអ្វីនៅទីនេះ។
សេនារីយ៉ូ
Upgrade គ្មាន mazer.v1 ⇒ cred="" មិនឆ្លង Precheck/Admit (T1) ⇒ goroutine + socket + HELLO 5 s, រហូត 64/IP ⇒ រាប់ក្នុង s.conns ⇒ Accepting(full) និង heartbeat connections ⇒ 400 IP (64 × 5 s វិល) ពេញ 25k ⇒ tickets ឈប់ទៅ node, node_unavailable ទូទៅ, client ពិតបាក់ទៅ shared host ⇒ hard cap ⇒ គ្មានអ្នកចូលថ្មី។ លំនាំ comment ថា 64 ព្រោះ a socket gets this far only with a good ticket — មិនពិតដរាបណា legacy នៅ (mod 0.2.1)។
ឫសគល់
Compatibility ទុក LB-2 រំលងការពារ; idle sockets រាប់ស្មើ session ក្នុង cap។
ដំណោះស្រាយដើម
ដំឡើង floor mod ≥ build មាន subprotocol ហើយ refuse upgrade គ្មាន mazer.v1 (ឬ limit legacy 4/IP + cap សកល មួយ %); មិនរាប់ idle ក្នុង Accepting។
ពិតឬអត់
ពិត: អ្នកណាក៏ដោយគ្មាន credential អាចបំពេញ capacity ដោយ socket 5 s; IPv6 /48 មួយមាន /64 រាប់ម៉ឺន ដូច្នេះមិនចាំបាច់ botnet។ លទ្ធផល: គ្មានអ្នកចូលថ្មីលើ node ដែលរងការវាយ។
No mazer.v1 skips Precheck and Admit (208-221); idle cap 64 per /64 (224); s.conns counts it (260) and Accepting uses it (196). No /48 cap; Cloudflare rule 2000/10 s per ip+colo (cfsetup.go:108) does not stop this.
ចេតនា
អចេតនា (server.go:46-48 'only with a good ticket' is false while the legacy branch stays (server.go:205-207))
ធ្វើអ្វី
ត្រូវកែ: server.go ServeHTTP: socket គ្មាន mazer.v1 រាប់ក្នុង legacy counter (4 ក្នុងមួយ key និង ≤ 5% Capacity) ហួស ⇒ 503; idle cap ទី២ តាម /48; Accepting រាប់តែ conn ដែល identified។ Mod បច្ចុប្បន្នមាន subprotocol។ Test ក្នុង idle_test.go; កែ comment។
ផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់
បញ្ជាក់ឯករាជ្យ (ពី medium): No mazer.v1 means no Precheck or Admit (208-221); 64 idle per IP; s.conns counts before IDENTIFY (260), 5 s timeout; comment at server.go:47 claims only a good ticket gets here.
ស្ថានភាព

សេនារីយ៉ូ
mazerctl node remove gw2 --dry-run → parseNodeRemove (nodefleet.go:202) បញ្ជូនទៅ parseNodeAdd ដែលទទួល --dry-run និង flag ផ្សេងៗ (--capacity...) → nodeFleetCmd ហៅ o.remove(ctx,p.Name,p.WGIP) ដោយមិនមើល p.DryRun → drain, revoke key, លុប WireGuard peer + pg_hba, លុប tunnel + DNS, rotate token api. ទាំងអស់កើតពិត។ node add និង release មាន --dry-run ពិត ដូច្នេះអ្នកប្រើសន្មតថាវាសុវត្ថិភាព។ គ្មានសំណួរបញ្ជាក់ ឬ --yes ទេ។
ឫសគល់
parseNodeRemove ខ្ចី parser របស់ node add ដោយមិនកំណត់ flag ដែលអនុញ្ញាត ហើយ remove គ្មានគំនិត dry-run ឬ confirmation។ Test មិនដែលសាក flag នេះ (nodefleet_test.go:314)។
ដំណោះស្រាយដើម
parseNodeRemove មាន parser ផ្ទាល់: ទទួលតែ --wg-ip, --existing, --dry-run; --dry-run បោះពុម្ពផែនការ ៨ ជំហាន ហើយឈប់; ករណីពិតទាមទារ --yes ឬវាយឈ្មោះ node។ បន្ថែម test ១។
ពិតឬអត់
ពិត: --dry-run លើ node remove ដកយក node ពិតមែន គ្មានសំណួរបញ្ជាក់។ មនុស្សសន្មតថាវាសុវត្ថិភាព ព្រោះ node add និង release មាន dry-run ពិត។
nodefleet.go:197 reuses parseNodeAdd, node.go:220 accepts --dry-run, nodefleet.go:177 calls remove ignoring p.DryRun. Revoke, tunnel delete and token rotation follow.
ចេតនា
អចេតនា (nodefleet.go:187 comment says parseNodeRemove reads only gwN and --wg-ip; node.go:59 usage lists no --dry-run)
ធ្វើអ្វី
ត្រូវកែ: parseNodeRemove (nodefleet.go) ទទួលតែ --wg-ip និង --existing; flag ផ្សេងទាំងអស់ = error (ដូច្នេះ --dry-run ឈប់ភ្លាម)។ បើចង់បាន dry-run ពិត ទើបបន្ថែមក្រោយ។ ពិនិត្យ: test ថា node remove gw2 --dry-run ត្រឡប់ error ហើយ fake fleet មិនត្រូវបានហៅ។
ផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់
បញ្ជាក់ឯករាជ្យ (ពី high): nodefleet.go:182 ignores p.DryRun; nodefleet.go:202 reuses parseNodeAdd, node.go:220 accepts --dry-run. Real drain, revoke, tunnel and token rotation follow. Limits: owner-only with settings, usage node.go:59 does not advertise the flag, nodefleet.go:243 refuses the last node, node add restores it.

ផ្ទៀងឡើងវិញ 2026-11-09
បញ្ជាក់ថាកែពិត ដោយអានកូដបច្ចុប្បន្ន · §00b
C-012 medium ត្រូវកែ កែរួច sign --version គ្មាន --expect ចុះហត្ថលេខាលើ files.json ណាក៏ដោយក្នុង R2: sha256 មិនត្រូវបានពិនិត្យនឹង byte
កន្លែង
cmd/mazerctl/manifest.go:415 · core · security · confirmed · ទំហំ M · session E · S6 S13
លក្ខខណ្ឌ
អ្នកវាយប្រហារសរសេរ R2 បាន; ម្ចាស់រត់ sign launcher stable --version V (ផ្លូវ rollback ដែលកូដណែនាំ) ឬ publish-setup --staged គ្មាន --expect
សេនារីយ៉ូ
ប្ដូរ launcher/V/x.exe ទៅជា malware ទំហំដូចគ្នា ហើយកែ sha256 ក្នុង files.json (immutable ត្រឹមតែជា convention ក្នុង Put) → versionFiles អាន list (manifest.go:536-544) → filesAsExpected រំលងពេល expect=nil (:494) → filesThere ពិនិត្យតែទំហំ (:517-526) → modVariants ទាញយក jar ពេញហើយ (modvariants.go:46) តែមិនគណនា sha ប្រៀបនឹង f.SHA256 (:58) → manifest ចុះហត្ថលេខាដោយ key ពិត → launcher ទាញយកហើយផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់ជាប់ → malware លើអ្នកប្រើទាំងអស់ រួមទាំងកុមារ។
ឫសគល់
ការការពារ --expect ដាក់តែលើ workflow CI (ADR 0065) មិនមែនជាលក្ខខណ្ឌក្នុង signOnce; ផ្លូវដោយដៃគ្មានប្រភពការពិតក្រៅ R2។
ដំណោះស្រាយដើម
តម្រូវឲ្យ --expect ជានិច្ចពេល --version គ្មាន --file (ឬអាន sha ពី GitHub release ដោយស្វ័យប្រវត្តិ); ទាញ byte ពី R2 ហើយគណនា sha256 មុនចុះហត្ថលេខា; --unverified ជាទង់ច្បាស់សម្រាប់ករណីបន្ទាន់។
ពិតឬអត់
ពិតផ្នែកខ្លះ: ផ្លូវ sign កែរួច តែផ្លូវ publish-setup --staged គ្មាន --expect នៅតែទុកចិត្ត byte ក្នុង R2 ដោយស្ងាត់។ អ្នកមានសិទ្ធិ R2 អាចប្ដូរ Setup បាន បើម្ចាស់រត់ដោយដៃ។
sign is fixed by 5fbbb2d (manifest.go:464, filesIntact :598). But setupfile.go:50 and :73-93: publish-setup --staged without --expect checks only MZ and size, then points latest.json at R2's bytes, with no warning.
ចេតនា
ចេតនា (setupfile.go:71 says expect is optional; manifest.go:302-305 covers sign only)
ធ្វើអ្វី
ត្រូវកែ: publishSetupCmd (setupfile.go): តម្រូវ --expect ឬ --unverified ដូច sign ហើយបង្ហាញ !! UNVERIFIED។ ពិនិត្យ: test ថា --staged គ្មាន flag ត្រឡប់ error ហើយ latest.json មិនប្ដូរ។
ផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់
បញ្ជាក់ឯករាជ្យ (ពី high): manifest.go:536-544 trusts files.json; :494 skips when expect nil; :517-526 size only, and size is editable too; modvariants.go:46-58 copies SHA without hashing. bad-release.en.md:16 tells owners to run this without --expect. Launcher manifest.rs:187-202 checks only manifest hash. Needs R2 write.

ផ្ទៀងឡើងវិញ 2026-11-09
បញ្ជាក់ថាកែពិត ដោយអានកូដបច្ចុប្បន្ន · §00b
C-014 medium ត្រូវកែ កែរួចស្រាប់ refresh_tokens កើនរាប់រយលានជួរ ហើយគ្មាន index លើ expires_at សម្រាប់ sweep
កន្លែង
migrations/20261004100000_identity.sql:60 · core · data · supported · ទំហំ M · session D · S10
លក្ខខណ្ឌ
launcher សកម្មធម្មតា
សេនារីយ៉ូ
AccessTTL 10 នាទី ដូច្នេះ launcher refresh រាល់ 10 នាទី; ជួរនីមួយៗនៅ RefreshTTL 60 ថ្ងៃ + 24 ម៉ោង (tables.go:72) ទោះប្រើរួចក៏ដោយ។ ប្រើ 4 ម៉ោង/ថ្ងៃ ≈ 1,460 ជួរ/អ្នក ⇒ 100k អ្នកប្រើ ≈ 146 លានជួរ។ Sweep រាល់ម៉ោងធ្វើ SELECT ctid WHERE expires_at < $1 LIMIT 5000 ដោយគ្មាន index = seq scan ទាំងតារាង; លើសពី transaction_timeout 10 s ⇒ session ត្រូវសម្លាប់ ⇒ Sweep ឈប់ (សូមមើលការរកឃើញ Sweep)។ ការប៉ាន់ស្មានចំនួន មិនទាន់វាស់ (DB បច្ចុប្បន្នទទេ)។
ឫសគល់
គ្រប់ token ដែលប្រើរួចត្រូវរក្សាដើម្បីចាប់ reuse ទាំងដែលអាចប្រើ generation ក្នុង family ជំនួស; migration used_nonces មាន index តែ refresh_tokens ត្រូវភ្លេច
ដំណោះស្រាយដើម
បន្ថែម index លើ expires_at (ក្នុង migration); កាត់ retention ជួរ used_at IS NOT NULL ទៅ ~7 ថ្ងៃ ឬរក្សាតែ generation/leaf ក្នុង token_families ហើយចាត់ refresh id មិនស្គាល់ក្នុង family ដែលនៅមានជីវិតជា reuse
ពិតឬអត់
ពិតផ្នែកខ្លះ: Index ខ្វះមែន ហើយការទុក token ដែលប្រើរួចជាការសម្រេចចិត្ត តែ seq scan ធំកើតតែពេលតារាងធំ ហើយមានជួរផុតតិច។ DB ឥឡូវតូច ដូច្នេះមិនទាន់ឈឺ តែនឹងឈឺពេល launch។
identity.sql:56-63 has no expires_at index; sweep.go:34 LIMIT 5000 stops early when many rows expired, full scan only when few have. AccessTTL 10 min, RefreshTTL 60 d (tokens.go:27-28). Row counts are projections.
ចេតនា
មិនដឹង (migrations/tables.go:72 chooses keeping used tokens to catch reuse; nothing explains the missing index, while used_nonces has one (20261005100000))
ធ្វើអ្វី
ត្រូវកែ: Migration ថ្មី: CREATE INDEX refresh_tokens_expires ON refresh_tokens (expires_at) ឥឡូវ ពេលតារាងនៅតូច (plain CREATE INDEX ល្មម) ហើយ atlas hash និង sqlc generate។ មិនបាច់ប្ដូរ retention ឡើយ។ ពិនិត្យដោយ EXPLAIN លើ sweepSQL ថាប្រើ index។
ផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់
ត្រូវផ្នែកខ្លះ (ពី high): identity.sql:56-63 no expires_at index; tables.go:72 keeps to expiry+24 h; sweep.go:34,60 scan with LIMIT and abort on error; pg.sh:152 timeout 10 s. LIMIT stops early once expired rows are found; full scan only when few expired. Harm needs millions of rows; DB empty now.
ការពិតអំពី index និង retention ត្រឹមត្រូវ ប៉ុន្តែ LIMIT 5000 ឈប់ scan ឆាប់ពេលមានជួរផុតកំណត់ច្រើន; scan ពេញកើតតែពេលជួរផុតកំណត់តិច។ លេខ 146 លានជួរជាការប៉ាន់ស្មានសម្រាប់ 100k អ្នកប្រើ ហើយ DB ឥឡូវទទេ ដូច្នេះជាបញ្ហាពេលកើនទំហំ មិនមែន outage ភ្លាមទេ: medium។

កែរួចស្រាប់ · goal D2 · core docs/worklog/2026-11-07-audit-D2.md · commit d8b6cc7; test 65b5a2e (បូកសរុប Z 2026-11-08)

បញ្ជាក់ថាកែពិត ដោយអានកូដបច្ចុប្បន្ន · §00b
C-015 medium ត្រូវកែ កែរួចស្រាប់ transaction_timeout 10 s លើ role ទាំងមូល សម្លាប់ batch job: rollup មិនដែលចប់ ហើយ telemetry ឆៅបាត់រហូតក្រោយ 7 ថ្ងៃ
កន្លែង
internal/analytics/rollup.go:82 · core · reliability · supported · ទំហំ M · session B · S10 S14
លក្ខខណ្ឌ
Postgres 17+ (bootstrap-host.sh:163, db-replica.sh:363) និង telemetry_events ធំគ្រប់គ្រាន់ (ប្រហែលរាប់លានជួរ)
សេនារីយ៉ូ
Rollup.Run ធ្វើ window មួយក្នុង transaction តែមួយ សម្រាប់គ្រប់ event ជាមួយ count(DISTINCT reporter); insights/rollup.go:48 ក៏ transaction តែមួយជាមួយ JOIN 30 ថ្ងៃ active_devices; archive.go:79 បើក query ខណៈសរសេរ Parquet ក្នុង memory។ លើស 10 s ⇒ Postgres សម្លាប់ session (FATAL) ⇒ job fail ⇒ Release ⇒ ព្យាយាមម៉ោងក្រោយ ⇒ fail ដដែល រហូតដល់ raw ផុត 7 ថ្ងៃ ⇒ dashboard និង rollup ដែលជាទិន្នន័យអចិន្ត្រៃយ៍បាត់។ Panel deadline 30 s (routes.go:183) ក៏ជាការកុហក: statement >10 s (CountPlayers, ReleaseReport, AuditChainBreaks) ទទួល 500 + Sentry មិនមែន 503 timeout។ មិនទាន់វាស់នៅកម្រិតផ្ទុកពិត។
ឫសគល់
timeout សម្រាប់ fence ពេល promote (blueprint 03 §6) ដាក់លើ role រួម ហើយមានតែ MigrateFleet ដែលបិទវា; job និង Panel មិនត្រូវបានគិត
ដំណោះស្រាយដើម
Helper db.Batch(ctx, pool, fn) ដែល SET LOCAL transaction_timeout = '5min' + statement_timeout សម្រាប់ job (rollup, archive, insights, sweep) ដោយនៅតែមើល epoch មុនដំណើរការ; ចែក rollup ជា transaction មួយក្នុងមួយ event; សាកផ្ទុក 7 ថ្ងៃលើ staging
ពិតឬអត់
ពិតផ្នែកខ្លះ: Timeout 10 s ពិតជាសម្លាប់ rollup និង Insights នៅពេលទិន្នន័យធំ (ប្រហែលលើស 1.5M ជួរ) ប៉ុន្តែ window នីមួយៗ commit ដាច់គ្នា ហើយប៉ះតែ analytics ដូច្នេះមិនមែនគ្រប់ job ទេ។
bootstrap-host.sh:163 sets 10 s; analytics/rollup.go:82 one tx per window across Registry; insights/rollup.go:48 one tx. No override. Hour and day windows commit apart; archive is per event/day. Earlier throwaway run: 19 s at 3M rows.
ចេតនា
មិនដឹង (docs/blueprint/03-target-architecture.md:100 chose the 10 s for promote fencing; nothing mentions batch jobs. db.go:190 exempts only migrations.)
ធ្វើអ្វី

សេនារីយ៉ូ
limits() រត់មុន handler: POST /v2/session {"kind":"premium"} គ្មាន proof ស៊ីទាំង 10/នាទី/IP និងពិដាន all 600/នាទី → 60 /64 ប្រើអស់ពិដាន → អ្នកលេង premium ទាំងអស់ទទួល 429 លើ node នោះ។ ដូចគ្នា: /v1/auth/register 6000/ម៉ោង (200 address, មុន PoW), /v1/auth/login និង refresh 30000/នាទី (500 address), /v1/nodes/* 600/នាទី (30 address, ស្ទះ node enroll/renew), /v1/installs។ គ្រប់ node មានថវិកាខ្លួនឯង ដូច្នេះ attacker ត្រូវចែកទៅគ្រប់ node តែនេះងាយ។

គិតពិដាន global តែក្រោយពិនិត្យតម្លៃថោក (challenge/signature/PoW ត្រឹមត្រូវ) ឬ charge តែពេលនឹងហៅ Mojang/DB; បន្ថែម rule per-/48 សម្រាប់ IPv6

ពិតផ្នែកខ្លះ: បញ្ហាធំត្រូវបានកាត់បន្ថយ (junk, IPv6 /64, register, refresh) តែ session premium នៅអាចស្ទះដោយ address ~60 ក្នុងមួយ node ព្រោះ server id សុំបានឥតគិតថ្លៃ។ /v1/nodes/* ស្ទះក៏មិនធ្ងន់ ព្រោះ renew ប្រើ cache ហើយ enroll retry។
6109f21 ceilings count only proved requests, /48 added. But a server id is free (GET /v2/session/challenge), so 60 addresses at 10/min still fill premium's 600/min (routes.go:446,449). /v1/nodes/* all stays unproved (routes.go:493).

សេនារីយ៉ូ
Loop DELETE /v1/me/skin ក្នុង keep-alive → ClearSkin បង្កើន rev (PutLoadout tx), Forget publish bus, a.changed → gateway.ProfileChanged publish bus ម្តងទៀត, ProfileChangedHere (watch.go:231-261) អាន Profiles ពី DB ព្រោះ cache ទើបលុប, ហើយរង្វិលជុំ c.mu លើគ្រប់ session ទាំង 25k លើគ្រប់ node រាល់ request។ PUT skin មាន 20/h និង PUT loadout 10/min (routes.go:301-302) តែ DELETE មិនមាន ក្នុង limitRules។ ផលប៉ះពាល់: CPU/lock/DB/bus លើ gateway គ្រប់អ្នក និងធ្លុះ budget ≤20 B/s សម្រាប់អ្នក watch (មិនបានវាស់ runtime)។
ឫសគល់
limit rule ស្រង់តាម method+path ម្តងមួយៗ គ្មាន default budget សម្រាប់ route សរសេររបស់ user; ដំណើរ profile change គ្មាន debounce ក្នុង user។
ដំណោះស្រាយដើម
បន្ថែម {DELETE /v1/me/skin, 20/h, user}; បន្ថែម test ថាគ្រប់ /v1/me write មាន rule (ដូច TestEveryAdminRouteIsRateLimited); coalesce ProfileChanged តាម user ~1s។
ពិតឬអត់
ពិត: អ្នកលេងម្នាក់ដែលមាន launcher token អាច loop DELETE បានគ្មានកំណត់ ហើយរាល់ request បង្កើត tx, bus និងរង្វិលជុំ session លើគ្រប់ node ទោះគាត់គ្មាន skin ក៏ដោយ។ ជាការធ្លាក់គុណភាព មិនមែនដាច់សេវាទេ។
routes.go:415-416 limit PUT skin and loadout; no DELETE rule and no default. cosmetics/skin.go:156-168 bumps rev even with no skin; gateway watch.go ProfileChangedHere loops every session when the user is online.
ចេតនា
មិនដឹង (ADR 0037:11 names the 20/h budget for PUT only and is silent on DELETE.)
ធ្វើអ្វី
ត្រូវកែ: បន្ថែម {"DELETE", "/v1/me/skin", ratelimit.New(20, time.Hour), user, nil} ក្នុង limitRules; ក្នុង ClearSkin បើ DELETE មិនបានលុបជួរ កុំ bump rev។ បន្ថែម test ថាគ្រប់ route សរសេរ /v1/me មាន rule ដូច TestEveryAdminRouteChecksTheRole។ coalesce មិនចាំបាច់ទេបន្ទាប់ពីមាន limit។
ផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់
បញ្ជាក់ឯករាជ្យ (ពី high): routes.go:301-302 limits PUT skin and loadout, no DELETE rule; no default rule. http.go MeDeleteSkin to ClearSkin to changed; watch.go:231-261 loops all sessions, returns early if user offline. Needs launcher token. Per-request cost milliseconds, not measured; degradation, not outage.
ខ្វះ rate limit ពិត ប៉ុន្តែផលប៉ះពាល់ជាការធ្លាក់គុណភាព: ត្រូវការ launcher token និងនៅ online ហើយ loop មួយជា lock ខ្លី ដូច្នេះ medium មិនមែន high។

Sweep ដក devices តែ public (migrations/tables.go:62); key ចាស់ revoked_at NULL ត្រូវរាប់រហូត។ Link លើកទី 11 → 409 too_many_devices sign one out first ប៉ុន្តែអ្នកលេងគ្មានផ្លូវ sign out។ Launcher នៅលើ home record: គ្រឿងលម្អ/ការទិញនៅលើ record មិនឃើញ។ Grief: session លួច 1 + register file key 10 (ជួល IP បន្តិច) ដាក់ពេញ slot។ Key file មិនចាំបាច់ public ដូច្នេះរាប់
ឫសគល់
Cap ត្រូវបានថែមជាការទប់សុវត្ថិភាព តែគ្មានអាយុ key ឬផ្លូវដក; ស៊ីជាមួយ finding ទី 1
ដំណោះស្រាយដើម
រាប់តែ key ដែល last_seen_at ក្នុង 90 ថ្ងៃ ឬដក device_players ដែលមិនប្រើ 180 ថ្ងៃ; បន្ថែមផ្លូវដកពី finding ទី 1; បើពេញ ផ្ដល់ឲ្យ proof ថ្មីទម្លាក់ key ចាស់បំផុត
ពិតឬអត់
ពិត: Key ចាស់មិនដែលអស់ ដូច្នេះ reinstall ច្រើនដង ឬអ្នកលួច session បំពេញ 10 slot ហើយកុំព្យូទ័រថ្មីរបស់ម្ចាស់ភ្ជាប់មិនបាន ដោយគ្មានផ្លូវដោះ។
records.go:166-170 counts every unrevoked non-public key forever; tables.go:62 sweeps only public devices; http.go:201 says sign one out first, which no route offers. File keys count too.
ចេតនា
មិនដឹង (ADR 0055:51 sets the cap; nothing on key age)
ធ្វើអ្វី
ត្រូវកែ: records.go:167 បន្ថែម AND d.last_seen_at > now() - interval '90 days' (key ដែលនៅប្រើនៅតែរាប់) ហើយផ្លូវដកមកពី C-003។ ពិនិត្យ: test 10 key អាយុ 91 ថ្ងៃ ហើយ link ទី 11 ឆ្លង។

បញ្ជាក់ថាកែពិត ដោយអានកូដបច្ចុប្បន្ន (និង test ខ្លះ) · §00
C-034 medium ត្រូវកែ កែរួចស្រាប់ Node ចាត់ 401 ទាំងអស់ថា key ត្រូវ revoke: nonce បាត់ពេល failover ឬ DB restore ធ្វើឲ្យ node drain ឬមិនព្រម start ចំពេលត្រូវការវាបំផុត
កន្លែង
internal/nodeid/boot.go:100 · core · reliability · confirmed · ទំហំ S · session C · S14 S12 S8
លក្ខខណ្ឌ
Node ចុះឈ្មោះតាម token (MAZER_ENROLL_URL) ឬ agent; DB ត្រូវ promote ឬ restore
សេនារីយ៉ូ
fail() ផ្គូ ErrRevoked, ErrBadProof, ErrBadNonce, ErrBadToken ទៅ 401 តែមួយ (http.go:65)។ Failover async: challenge សរសេរលើ primary ចាស់ លិចក្នុង lag → renew ឆ្លើយ ErrBadNonce 401 → Renewing ហៅ revoked() ហើយ return (loop ចប់) → drainRevoked កំណត់ drain ហើយគ្មានអ្នកដកវិញ។ Boot (boot.go:63) ឃើញ 401 → បរាជ័យ start ដោយសារ key was revoked, មិនប្រើ cache ដែលសរសេរទុកសម្រាប់ពេល Core ខូច។ ករណីខ្លាំងជាងនេះ: DB ស្ដារពី backup ចាស់ជាង enrollment ឬ replica lag → key មិនស្គាល់ → ErrRevoked (Renew រកមិនឃើញ row) ⇒ node token ទាំងអស់ drain, restart មិនបាន, agent restart ក៏មិនបាន ខណៈកំពុងស្ដារ។ TestRenewing សាកតែ revoke ពិត
ឫសគល់
Protocol មានតែលេខ status សម្រាប់ប្រាប់ និងគ្មានកូដ final ដាច់ពីគ្នា; unknown key និង revoked ក៏មិនបែងចែក (query UPDATE ... revoked_at IS NULL មិនដឹងពីមូលហេតុ)
ដំណោះស្រាយដើម
Problem code node_revoked សម្រាប់ row មាន revoked_at តែប៉ុណ្ណោះ; bad nonce/unknown key = code ផ្សេងដែលសាកឡើងវិញ; client ពិនិត្យ code មិនមែន 401; Renewing បន្ដ loop; Boot ប្រើ cache លើអ្វីមិនមែន node_revoked; បន្ថែម test ដោយលុប node_challenges row រវាង challenge និង renew
ពិតឬអត់
ពិត: Unknown key ជាការសម្រេចក្នុង ADR តែវាធ្វើឲ្យ node បដិសេធ start ពេលស្ដារ DB ចាស់ ហើយ nonce បាត់ក៏ត្រូវចាត់ថា revoke ដែរ: សារកុហក និង node ដាច់ចំពេលវិបត្តិ។ បង្អួច nonce ខ្លី តែករណីស្ដារ DB ពិតជាធ្ងន់។
http.go:65 maps ErrRevoked, ErrBadProof, ErrBadNonce, ErrBadToken to 401; boot.go:63 refuses start; boot.go:100 drains and stops the loop; server.go:293 returns ErrRevoked for a missing row. Failover not run.
ចេតនា
ចេតនា (ADR 0088 #5 says revoked or unknown key is 401; server.go:27 names it. Bad nonce as revoked has no paper trail)
ធ្វើអ្វី
ត្រូវកែ: fail() ឲ្យ code ដាច់: node_revoked (តែ row មាន revoked_at), node_unknown, bad_nonce។ Renew ត្រូវអាន row ដើម្បីបែងចែក។ StatusError មាន Code ពី problem; Boot និង Renewing ចាត់ថា final តែ node_revoked; ផ្សេងទៀតប្រើ cache + log ERROR។ node ចាស់ឃើញ 401 ដដែល។ ពិនិត្យ: test លុប row node_identities ហើយ Boot start ពី cache; លុប node_challenges ហើយ Renewing បន្ត។

កន្លែង
internal/identity/queries.sql:72 · core · performance · confirmed · ទំហំ S · session C · S9 S10
លក្ខខណ្ឌ
តារាង identities ធំឡើង (មួយរយពាន់ជួរឡើងទៅ); អ្នកហៅមិនចាំបាច់ login
សេនារីយ៉ូ
WHERE kind='premium' AND lower(display_name)=lower($1): migrations មាន identities_user និង identities_verified_once (kind, subject) តែ គ្មាន expression index (grep lower(display_name) ក្នុង migrations ទទេ)។ ផ្លូវមិនតម្រូវ auth: POST /v2/session offline (ពិដាន 600 ទៅ 6000/នាទី), ផ្លូវ gateway resolve claim (gateway/server.go:740, លើ pool gateway តូច) និង support។ ពេលព្យុះ reconnect ឬ launch សំណួរកម្រិត scan វិនាទីនីមួយៗរាប់សិប ប៉ះ budget API p99 < 50 ms និង pool gateway ដែល LB-1.12 ទុកឲ្យ IDENTIFY
ឫសគល់
Query ត្រូវបានបន្ថែមសម្រាប់ AddOffline (ផ្លូវកម្រ) រួចយកទៅប្រើលើផ្លូវក្ដៅដោយមិនឆ្លុះ index; ponytail នៅ SearchPlayers កត់តែ search
ដំណោះស្រាយដើម
Migration: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY identities_premium_name ON identities (lower(display_name)) WHERE kind = 'premium' (migration ស្របតាម expand-only)
ពិតឬអត់
ពិតផ្នែកខ្លះ: Scan ជួរ premium ទាំងអស់រាល់ offline session មានពិត។ ផ្លូវ gateway មាន cache ក្នុង connection ដូច្នេះមិនធ្ងន់ដូចសរសេរ ហើយប៉ះតែពេលតារាងធំ។
queries.sql:72 has no matching index (grep lower(display_name) in migrations empty); session.go:167 calls it uncached per offline session. gateway/server.go:740 caches per connection (AccountsTTL), so the gateway share is overstated.
ចេតនា
មិនដឹង (players.go:28 ponytail covers search only)
ធ្វើអ្វី
ត្រូវកែ: Migration: CREATE INDEX identities_premium_name ON identities (lower(display_name)) WHERE kind = 'premium'; ឥឡូវតារាងនៅតូច មិនចាំបាច់ CONCURRENTLY។ ពិនិត្យ: EXPLAIN + atlas hash។

blocks.go:90 value+reason; sanctions.go:125 reason; reports.go:123 note; notify.go:179 title_en. export.go:52-54 exports only target user:<self>, so no cross-player leak. Trigger blocks erase for a year.

Bus event block.added → gateway បិទ session តាម IP/device; ត្រួតពិនិត្យ device ក្នុង ticket/RESUME; សរសេរច្បាស់ក្នុង spec ថា device block ក្រៅ scope v2 ឬប្រើ IP បន្ថែម។
ពិតឬអត់
ពិត: IP block ចាប់តែ upgrade ថ្មី ហើយ socket ដែលបើករួចនៅរស់ រីឯ device block មិនចាប់ gateway/RESUME និង mod តាម v2 ទេ។ នេះផ្ទុយពីអ្វីដែល spec សរសេរ។
Blocked has one caller, routes.go:226. AddBlock only forgets cache (blocks.go:70-99). /v1/gateway carries no device claims (identity/http.go:56). Nothing closes open sockets; POST /v2/session has no device.
ចេតនា
អចេតនា (routes.go:215-216 and openapi.yaml:3895-3896 promise every player route including the gateway)
ធ្វើអ្វី
ត្រូវកែ: បន្ថែមក្នុង node.backstop (cmd/mazerd/cluster.go:658, 30 s ដូច ban): យក session ដែល c.ip/c.device ត្រូវ block ហើយ Close។ កែ spec ថា device block មិនគ្រប v2។ test: block ពេល socket បើក ⇒ បិទក្នុង 30 s។

កន្លែង
internal/moderation/blocks.go:169 · core · performance · confirmed · ទំហំ S · session C · S8 S9
លក្ខខណ្ឌ
DB យឺត/failover, ឬ reload ធម្មតាក្នុង request ទាំងអស់
សេនារីយ៉ូ
Blocked: c.mu.Lock() + defer; reload s.Blocks(rctx) timeout 2 s នៅក្រោម lock (:175-177) ⇒ request ផ្សេងទាំងអស់ក្នុងខណៈនោះរង់ចាំ (គ្រប់ /v1, /v2 ក្រៅ admin) ⇒ DB blip = 2 s កកម្ដងរៀងរាល់ 30 s (≈6.7 % នៃពេល) បែក p99 < 50 ms ជាប់ផ្ទាល់ middleware។ reload ប្រើ request goroutine, scan IP O(n) ក្រោម lock ដូចគ្នា។
ឫសគល់
Cache refresh inline ក្រោម lock ជំនួសឲ្យ background + atomic snapshot។
ដំណោះស្រាយដើម
atomic.Pointer snapshot; refresh ក្នុង goroutine ដាច់ (singleflight) ឬ ticker, request អានគ្មាន lock។
ពិតឬអត់
ពិត: ពិត៖ ក្នុង lock តែមួយ request ទាំងអស់រង់ចាំពេលអាន DB ដូច្នេះ DB យឺតធ្វើឲ្យកក 2 s រៀងរាល់ 30 s សូម្បីផ្លូវដែលមិនត្រូវការ DB។ 2 s ជាការជ្រើសរើស តែការកាន់ lock ធ្វើឲ្យផលប៉ះពាល់រាលដាលពេញ node។
blocks.go:168-177 lock held across s.Blocks with 2 s timeout; routes.go:220-226 runs it on every /v1 and /v2 player route. Normal reload costs ms; slow DB freezes all such requests 2 s every 30 s.
ចេតនា
ចេតនា (internal/moderation/blocks.go:172-173 never longer than 2 s of a request: a slow database keeps the last list)
ធ្វើអ្វី
ត្រូវកែ: ក្នុង Blocked៖ កំណត់ c.at ក្រោម lock រួចដោះ lock ហើយអានក្នុង goroutine មួយ (context.Background + timeout 2 s) រួច lock ខ្លីដើម្បីជំនួស c.ips/c.devices។ Request ប្រើបញ្ជីចាស់ភ្លាម; forget() នៅតែមានផល។ ដំបូងពេល list ទទេ អាចរង់ចាំអានលើកទីមួយបាន។ ពិនិត្យ៖ test DB យឺត Blocked ត្រឡប់ក្រោម 50 ms។

C-046 medium ត្រូវកែ កែរួចស្រាប់ CompareHead ប្រៀបតែ copy ថ្មីបំផុត ⇒ CopyHead បន្ទាប់ដាក់ head ក្លែង ហើយ tamper លែងឃើញជារៀងរហូត
កន្លែង
internal/audit/head.go:74 · core · security · confirmed · ទំហំ S · session A · S12 S13
លក្ខខណ្ឌ
អ្នកមានសិទ្ធិសរសេរ DB (node ត្រូវ revoke នៅកាន់ URL DB, SEC-1) ដែលជា threat model ផ្ទាល់របស់ S12
សេនារីយ៉ូ
បិទ trigger, UPDATE row ហើយគណនា hash ឡើងវិញពី row នោះដល់ចុង (audit_hash គ្មាន key) ⇒ Verify ស្អាត។ HeadLoop រាល់ 6 h សរសេរជាន់ key ថ្ងៃនេះដោយ head ថ្មី (head.go:48)។ CompareHead រត់តែម្ដងក្នុងមួយម៉ោង ពេល Attention ត្រូវហៅ (attention.go:172) ហើយ break ត្រង់ copy ដំបូងដែលរកឃើញ (:75-76) ⇒ ក្រោយ CopyHead គ្មាន mismatch ទេ។ Copy ថ្ងៃមុនៗនៅក្នុង R2 ត្រឹមត្រូវ តែគ្មានកូដណាប្រៀបវា។ head_test.go:104 សាកតែ hash=\x00 មិនសាក rewrite + copy ឡើងវិញ។
ឫសគល់
Head copy ជា snapshot តែមួយត្រូវជាន់ ហើយការប្រៀបមិនពិនិត្យថា chain ថ្មីបន្តពី head ចាស់; គ្មាន state ចាំ head ដែលបានផ្ទៀងរួច។
ដំណោះស្រាយដើម
CopyHead បដិសេធ/បង្កើត incident បើ head មុន (day-1, day-2…) មិននៅក្នុង DB ជាមុនសិន; CompareHead ដើរគ្រប់ copy N ថ្ងៃ; key ក្នុងមួយការចម្លង (dt=…/id=…) មិនជាន់; test rewrite-then-copy។
ពិតឬអត់
ពិត: ពិត៖ បើសរសេរ chain ឡើងវិញមុន CopyHead បន្តិច head ក្លែងជាន់ copy ហើយ CompareHead លែងឃើញ។ នេះខុសពីអ្វីដែល comment ក្នុង audit.go អះអាង។ ត្រូវមានសិទ្ធិសរសេរ DB ជាមុន ដូច្នេះ medium។
head.go:48 overwrites today's key every 6 h, with no check; head.go:74-76 stops at newest copy; attention.go:173-193 compares hourly. Rewrite shortly before a copy is never seen. No code reads older copies.
ចេតនា
អចេតនា (internal/audit/audit.go:13-15 and head.go:36-38 claim a rewrite shows against the copies; test head_test.go:106 covers only no re-copy)
ធ្វើអ្វី
ត្រូវកែ: ក្នុង CopyHead មុន Put ហៅ CompareHead; បើ ErrHeadMismatch កុំ Put ហើយ return error ⇒ copy ល្អនៅ ហើយ alert នៅជាប់រហូត។ promote accept_loss បាត់ row ត្រឹមត្រូវ ត្រូវមានផ្លូវ mazerctl ទទួលស្គាល់ head ថ្មី។ ពិនិត្យ៖ test rewrite + CopyHead ត្រូវ error ហើយ object មិនប្ដូរ។

internal/admin/attention.go:189 · core · security · confirmed · ទំហំ M · session A · S12 S8 S13
លក្ខខណ្ឌ
Node/env ត្រូវលួច (មាន DB + MAZER_ARCHIVE_*), ឬ R2 មិនឆ្លើយ
សេនារីយ៉ូ
(1) head.go comment ថាអ្នកសរសេរ DB មិនអាចប៉ះ copy តែ mazerd ដូចគ្នាកាន់ key R2 write ក្នុង env (main.go:249) គ្មាន object lock ⇒ លុបគ្រប់ audit/head/ ហើយ CompareHead ត្រឡប់ nil 'no copy' (head.go:82)។ (2) attention.go:189 យកតែ ErrHeadMismatch ⇒ error ផ្សេងទៅស្ងាត់ ហើយ bucketItems បង្កើត items ថ្មីគ្មាន mismatch ទុក 1 ម៉ោង (:193) ⇒ alert critical 'resolve' ខ្លួនឯងពេល R2 blip។ (3) HeadLoop fail មានតែ log (head.go:59) គ្មាន Attention; Archive មិនកំណត់ ⇒ tamper check បិទស្ងាត់ (main.go:248, :381)។
ឫសគល់
ការពារត្រូវការ write-once ឬ credential ដាច់ពី node តែ design ប្រើ key ដូចគ្នា ហើយចាត់ទុក 'មិនដឹង' = 'ល្អ'។
ដំណោះស្រាយដើម
R2 bucket lock/versioning ឬ copy ទីពីរក្រៅ Core (healthchecks/Telegram រាល់ថ្ងៃផ្ញើ head hash); attention kinds: audit_head_stale, audit_head_unreadable; រក្សា mismatch រហូតម្ចាស់ acknowledge។
ពិតឬអត់
ពិត: ទាំងបីចំណុចពិត៖ node ត្រូវលួចមាន key លុប copy បាន, R2 error លុប alert critical, ហើយ job ឈប់គ្មាន alert។ 'មិនដឹង = ល្អ' ជាការជ្រើសរើស តែសម្រាប់ tamper check វាខុស។
attention.go:193 only ErrHeadMismatch makes an item; :204 caches an hour, so an R2 error drops the alert. head.go:59 failure logs only. main.go:248-253, 381 same key writes; no object lock in repo.

ចេតនា (internal/audit/head.go:68 No copy yet is no finding; internal/admin/attention.go:198-199 Unreadable is left out, as above)

ត្រូវកែ: កូដ៖ ក្នុង bucketItems បើ CompareHead error ផ្សេង រក្សា mismatch ចាស់ ហើយបន្ថែម item audit_head_unreadable; បើ copy ថ្ងៃនេះ/ម្សិលមិញបាត់ខណៈ AuditBucket មាន ឲ្យ item audit_head_stale។ ម្ចាស់ធ្វើក្រៅកូដ៖ បើក R2 bucket lock លើ prefix audit/head/ (Cloudflare ឥតគិតថ្លៃ)។ ពិនិត្យ៖ test ជាមួយ bucket ដែលត្រឡប់ error។

C-048 medium ត្រូវកែ កែរួចស្រាប់ Lock chain audit សកល + synchronous remote_write ⇒ replica stall ស្ទះ pool ពេល premium ថ្មីចូល
កន្លែង
migrations/20261003130000_audit_events.sql:32 · core · reliability · supported · ទំហំ M · session D · S8 S9 S10
លក្ខខណ្ឌ
មាន replica sync; launch day ឬ replica ចុះ មុន timer ដកឈ្មោះ (OPS-26: 10-15 s)
សេនារីយ៉ូ
Trigger កាន់ pg_advisory_xact_lock រហូត commit; audit.Record ដាក់ SET LOCAL synchronous_commit = remote_write (audit.go:52) ⇒ commit នីមួយៗរង់ replica ខណៈកាន់ lock ⇒ audit writer ទាំងអស់ជាជួរ។ identity.premium_session_created ក្នុង premiumHolder (session.go:143) ដើរក្នុង request អ្នកលេង ≤ 600/នាទី សរុប, ក៏ cosmetics.redeem, privacy.export, ban។ Replica stall 15 s ⇒ ≥ 150 tx កាន់ connection > pool REST ⇒ API ទាំងមូលចាំ deadline 10 s ⇒ 503 ទោះផ្លូវមិនទាក់ទង audit។ មិនទាន់វាស់ (load test គ្មាន)។
ឫសគល់
Chain ត្រូវការ writer តែមួយ ប៉ុន្តែ row ប្រភេទ system ដែលកើតពី player traffic ក៏ប្រើ chain និង durability កម្រិតខ្ពស់ដូច action staff។
ដំណោះស្រាយដើម
identity.* ពី traffic: outbox + writer តែមួយក្នុង job (bulk ក្នុង tx ដាច់) មិនក្នុង request; lock_timeout/statement_timeout ខ្លីលើ audit; synchronous_commit=local សម្រាប់ row system។
ពិតឬអត់
ពិតផ្នែកខ្លះ: ពិតមែន ប៉ុន្តែកើតតែពេល replica stall ព្រមជាមួយ audit writer ច្រើនក្នុងពេលតែមួយ (launch day)។ ការរចនា chain ជាការសម្រេចចិត្ត តែ pool REST អាចពេញ ហើយ API ទាំងមូល 503 ក្នុងរយៈពេលនោះ។
Trigger lock plus audit.go:52 remote_write hold across commit wait. Needs a burst: premium audit fires only for created accounts (session.go:147). wal_sender_timeout is unset (default 60 s), so a stall ends in about 70 s. Unmeasured.
ចេតនា

ឫសគល់
Reports ត្រូវរចនាសម្រាប់ volume តូច; limit ការពារការចុច មិនការពារ sybil។

Rule IP + សរុប + cap open reports/reporter; cursor pagination + filter status=open oldest-first; group by target ជាមួយចំនួន reporter។

ពិត: ពិត៖ flood ពីគណនីច្រើនអាចរុញ report ចាស់ចេញពី 500 ដែល Panel បង្ហាញ។ Attention នៅបង្ហាញចំនួន និងថ្ងៃចាស់បំផុត ដូច្នេះម្ចាស់ដឹងថាមានកកស្ទះ តែមើលជួរនោះមិនឃើញ។
